{"parentUuid":"3ccc3333-cd6b-4f1e-b901-e53ce64634cf","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"signature":"","thinking":"Let me start writing files. \n\nI've confirmed the project will be named incremental-checkpoint-engine with the crate identifier 'ice', and I've sorted out all required source file entries. I've finalized the fixed-page design: each page must be exactly page_size bytes, initialized to zero, and any write operation to a page must strictly match this length requirement. I've confirmed that the hex API requires the write payload length to exactly match page size, and the full fixed content including zeros needs to be digested. I've also decided to store each page as a file with a header, with unwritten pages treated as zeros for digest calculation.\n\nI've finalized the page file header structure, confirmed the dataset state JSON format and the optional tip field for quick listing, and decided to fsync the checkpoint after creation.\n\nI've finalized the checkpoint directory structure and metadata format, confirmed full checkpoints include all pages while incremental ones only list changed pages, with corresponding data files ordered by page number.\n\nI've finalized the page checksum rule: each page uses CRC32 of its payload, with an additional data_crc field covering the full data file, and per-page CRCs will be recalculated during restoration for structural verification. I've chosen a decimal monotonic counter for ID generation to avoid external date dependencies, and sorted out the crash-safe checkpoint creation protocol.\n\nI've finalized the state update process for checkpoint creation, decided to clear all .staging directories on restart, and sorted out the complete recovery rules covering checkpoint loading, error detection and page application order.\n\nI've finalized the post-creation validation workflow, confirmed the working page file atomic writing process, and decided to update the tip field to the target checkpoint ID during recovery to support checkpoint branching.\n\nI've finalized the merge checkpoint design: it only supports incremental checkpoints, will record the merged source ID in metadata with a null parent, retain the original content and working state, and adopt an atomic implementation with automatic garbage cleanup on restart and verification against page CRCs.\n\nI've confirmed merged page digests can be compared via restore or materialize view endpoints, decided not to support in-place merge for immutable checkpoints, and designed the digest query interface with a shared chain resolution module for both restore and merge operations.\n\nI've finalized the core VFS trait definition covering all required file system operations, and confirmed the sync durability boundary: a successful atomic write operation ensures checkpoint durability even on power loss on POSIX systems.\n\nI've finalized the design for the fault injection module, which wraps the underlying VFS implementation to support multiple fault modes including fail-once, crash simulation and data corruption. I've also confirmed the fault rule structure, fault injection entry, and corresponding test scenarios for merge interruption and checksum mismatch.\n\nI've finalized the POST /fault endpoint design for fault configuration, confirmed granular fault points covering all core operations, and sorted out the controller's set/clear and reset logic.\n\nI've finalized the fault injection rules for corruption scenarios: the CorruptByte action will flip bytes at specified offsets after raw writes, while checkpoint corruption tests will use direct file edits for explicit checksum verification.\n\nI've finalized the in-memory reference model for test scenarios, clarified the diff logic for incremental checkpoints against parent checkpoints, and confirmed the full map resolution and payload storage rules for the engine diff module.\n\nI've finalized the complete HTTP API design covering all operations for datasets, checkpoints, fault injection and health checks, and confirmed the concurrency processing architecture with a thread-per-connection model and shared repository locking mechanism.\n\nI've finalized the HTTP request processing rule using read-until-header-parsing and per-request close logic, confirmed the JSON module's numeric handling scheme, and selected the standard IEEE table-based CRC32 implementation.\n\nI've finalized the error type design for the engine and HTTP status mapping rules, and sorted out the module architecture for the core codebase.\n\nI've finalized the remaining module arrangements, test coverage requirements and initial Cargo.toml configuration with no external dependencies. Next I'll write the code following Rust correctness standards.\n\nI've finished implementing the IEEE table-based CRC32 algorithm in the crc32.rs module, confirmed that the const fn with loop feature in Rust 2021 edition can support the required static table calculation, and the implementation is valid.\n\nI've confirmed the CRC32 output uses 8 lowercase hexadecimal characters, finalized the JSON value enum structure for insertion order preservation, and designed a standard recursive descent parser with basic escape handling and whitespace skipping.\n\nI've confirmed the JSON numeric parsing scheme, decided to use helper constructors instead of a dedicated json! builder, and finalized the VFS trait definition covering all required file system operations. I've sorted out the implementation logic for core VFS methods, the uniqueness rule for temporary file names, and the delegating design for the fault injection wrapper.\n\nI've decided to add a fault check method to the VFS trait, with InjectVfs overriding it to invoke the controller for explicit operation point verification. Error types shared by the engine.\n\nuse std::fmt;\nuse std::io;\n\n/// All engine errors.\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum EngineError {\n    /// Underlying I/O failure (possibly injected).\n    Io(io::Error),\n    /// JSON parse/serialize failure.\n    Json(String),\n    /// A name (dataset/checkpoint) is malformed or unsafe.\n    BadName(String),\n    /// The referenced dataset does not exist.\n    DatasetNotFound(String),\n    /// The dataset already exists.\n    DatasetExists(String),\n    /// The referenced checkpoint does not exist.\n    CheckpointNotFound(String),\n    /// A checkpoint references a missing parent checkpoint id.\n    MissingParent { id: String, parent: String },\n    /// The dependency chain contains a cycle.\n    Cycle(String),\n    /// A stored page or checkpoint file fails structural validation.\n    Corrupt(String),\n    /// CRC checksum mismatch (`expected`, `actual`).\n    ChecksumMismatch { expected: String, actual: String },\n    /// Invalid request parameters.\n    Invalid(String),\n    /// An operation failed because an injected fault point fired.\n    Injected(String),\n}\n\nimpl fmt::Display for EngineError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            EngineError::Io(e) => write!(f, \"io error: {e}\"),\n            EngineError::Json(s) => write!(f, \"json error: {s}\"),\n            EngineError::BadName(s) => write!(f, \"bad name: {s}\"),\n            EngineError::DatasetNotFound(s) => write!(f, \"dataset not found: {s}\"),\n            EngineError::DatasetExists(s) => write!(f, \"dataset already exists: {s}\"),\n            EngineError::CheckpointNotFound(s) => write!(f, \"checkpoint not found: {s}\"),\n            EngineError::MissingParent { id, parent } => {\n                write!(f, \"checkpoint {id} references missing parent {parent}\")\n            }\n            EngineError::Cycle(id) => write!(f, \"dependency cycle detected at checkpoint {id}\"),\n            EngineError::Corrupt(s) => write!(f, \"corrupt storage: {s}\"),\n            EngineError::ChecksumMismatch { expected, actual } => {\n                write!(f, \"checksum mismatch: expected {expected}, got {actual}\")\n            }\n            EngineError::Invalid(s) => write!(f, \"invalid request: {s}\"),\n            EngineError::Injected(s) => write!(f, \"injected fault: {s}\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::error::Error for EngineError {\n    fn source(&self) -> Option<&(dyn std::error::Error + 'static)> {\n        match self {\n            EngineError::Io(e) => Some(e),\n            _ => None,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl From<io::Error> for EngineError {\n    fn from(e: io::Error) -> Self {\n        EngineError::Io(e)\n    }\n}\n\npub type EngineResult<T> = Result<T, EngineError>;\n\n/// Stable short machine-readable error codes used by the HTTP layer.\nimpl EngineError {\n    pub fn code(&self) -> &'static str {\n        match self {\n            EngineError::Io(_) => \"io_error\",\n            EngineError::Json(_) => \"json_error\",\n            EngineError::BadName(_) => \"bad_name\",\n            EngineError::DatasetNotFound(_) => \"dataset_not_found\",\n            EngineError::DatasetExists(_) => \"dataset_exists\",\n            EngineError::CheckpointNotFound(_) => \"checkpoint_not_found\",\n            EngineError::MissingParent { .. } => \"missing_parent\",\n            EngineError::Cycle(_) => \"dependency_cycle\",\n            EngineError::Corrupt(_) => \"corrupt\",\n            EngineError::ChecksumMismatch { .. } => \"checksum_mismatch\",\n            EngineError::Invalid(_) => \"invalid_request\",\n            EngineError::Injected(_) => \"injected_fault\",\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// HTTP status used by the verification server.\n    pub fn http_status(&self) -> u16 {\n        match self {\n            EngineError::DatasetNotFound(_) | EngineError::CheckpointNotFound(_) => 404,\n            EngineError::DatasetExists(_) => 409,\n            EngineError::MissingParent { .. } | EngineError::Cycle(_) => 409,\n            EngineError::Corrupt(_) | EngineError::ChecksumMismatch { .. } => 409,\n            EngineError::BadName(_) | EngineError::Invalid(_) | EngineError::Json(_) => 400,\n            EngineError::Injected(_) => 500,\n            EngineError::Io(_) => 500,\n        }\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_cc34d2153dd0dc08039b3777","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":3286,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":26424,"output_tokens":2452,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"f4416d62-be95-4011-8b52-840059630b39","timestamp":"2026-09-22T15:51:13.735Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/a","sessionId":"6799847f-f3d2-4c99-9138-f5e47176be70","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-a","slug":"merry-wobbling-mochi"}
{"parentUuid":"f4416d62-be95-4011-8b52-840059630b39","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_xlf98837wwvf8emna74spsd9","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/a/src/crc32.rs","content":"//! CRC-32 (ISO-HDLC / IEEE 802.3, poly 0xEDB88320 reflected).\n//!\n//! Used for page content checksums and data-file checksums. Implemented with a\n//! const-generated lookup table so no external crate is required.\n\nconst TABLE: [u32; 256] = {\n    let mut table = [0u32; 256];\n    let mut i = 0usize;\n    while i < 256 {\n        let mut c = i as u32;\n        let mut k = 0;\n        while k < 8 {\n            c = if c & 1 != 0 { 0xEDB88320 ^ (c >> 1) } else { c >> 1 };\n            k += 1;\n        }\n        table[i] = c;\n        i += 1;\n    }\n    table\n};\n\n/// Compute CRC-32 over `data`.\npub fn crc32(data: &[u8]) -> u32 {\n    let mut c: u32 = 0xFFFF_FFFF;\n    for &b in data {\n        c = TABLE[((c ^ b as u32) & 0xFF) as usize] ^ (c >> 8);\n    }\n    c ^ 0xFFFF_FFFF\n}\n\n/// CRC-32 as 8 lowercase hex characters.\npub fn crc32_hex(data: &[u8]) -> String {\n    format!(\"{:08x}\", crc32(data))\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn known_vectors() {\n        // Standard check vector: CRC32(\"123456789\") == 0xCBF43926\n        assert_eq!(crc32(b\"123456789\"), 0xCBF4_3926);\n        assert_eq!(crc32(b\"\"), 0);\n        assert_eq!(crc32_hex(b\"123456789\"), \"cbf43926\");\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn differs_on_single_byte() {\n        assert_ne!(crc32(b\"hello world\"), crc32(b\"hello worlD\"));\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_cc34d2153dd0dc08039b3777","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":3286,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":26424,"output_tokens":2452,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"97ece8d0-7563-497e-b020-e44d0090a3b0","timestamp":"2026-09-22T15:51:13.820Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/a","sessionId":"6799847f-f3d2-4c99-9138-f5e47176be70","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-a","slug":"merry-wobbling-mochi"}

Small lower/upper hex helpers (std-only).\n\nuse crate::error::{EngineError, EngineResult};\n\npub fn encode_lower(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {\n    let mut s = String::with_capacity(bytes.len() * 2);\n    for b in bytes {\n        s.push(nibble(b >> 4));\n        s.push(nibble(b & 0x0F));\n    }\n    s\n}\n\nfn nibble(n: u8) -> char {\n    match n {\n        0..=9 => (b'0' + n) as char,\n        _ => (b'a' + n - 10) as char,\n    }\n}\n\npub fn decode(s: &str) -> EngineResult<Vec<u8>> {\n    let bytes = s.as_bytes();\n    if bytes.len() % 2 != 0 {\n        return Err(EngineError::Invalid(\"hex string has odd length\".into()));\n    }\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(bytes.len() / 2);\n    let mut i = 0;\n    while i < bytes.len() {\n        let hi = val(bytes[i], i)?;\n        let lo = val(bytes[i + 1], i + 1)?;\n        out.push((hi << 4) | lo);\n        i += 2;\n    }\n    Ok(out)\n}\n\nfn val(b: u8, pos: usize) -> EngineResult<u8> {\n    match b {\n        b'0'..=b'9' => Ok(b - CRC-32 (ISO-HDLC / IEEE 802.3, poly 0xEDB88320 reflected).\n//!\n//! Used for page content checksums and data-file checksums. Implemented with a\n//! const-generated lookup table so no external crate is required.\n\nconst TABLE: [u32; 256] = {\n    let mut table = [0u32; 256];\n    let mut i = 0usize;\n    while i < 256 {\n        let mut c = i as u32;\n        let mut k = 0;\n        while k < 8 {\n            c = if c & 1 != 0 { 0xEDB88320 ^ (c >> 1) } else { c >> 1 };\n            k += 1;\n        }\n        table[i] = c;\n        i += 1;\n    }\n    table\n};\n\n/// Compute CRC-32 over `data`.\npub fn crc32(data: &[u8]) -> u32 {\n    let mut c: u32 = 0xFFFF_FFFF;\n    for &b in data {\n        c = TABLE[((c ^ b as u32) & 0xFF) as usize] ^ (c >> 8);\n    }\n    c ^ 0xFFFF_FFFF\n}\n\n/// CRC-32 as 8 lowercase hex characters.\npub fn crc32_hex(data: &[u8]) -> String {\n    format!(\"{:08x}\", crc32(data))\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn known_vectors() {\n        // Standard check vector: CRC32(\"123456789\") == 0xCBF43926\n        assert_eq!(crc32(b\"123456789\"), 0xCBF4_3926);\n        assert_eq!(crc32(b\"\"), 0);\n        assert_eq!(crc32_hex(b\"123456789\"), \"cbf43926\");\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn differs_on_single_byte() {\n        assert_ne!(crc32(b\"hello world\"), crc32(b\"hello worlD\"));\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"97ece8d0-7563-497e-b020-e44d0090a3b0","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/a","sessionId":"6799847f-f3d2-4c99-9138-f5e47176be70","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-a","slug":"merry-wobbling-mochi"}

{"parentUuid":"495bdfb5-2249-468a-9d17-fb4c0c1cbc61","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_61ptdsqx3f0osyp85mfe849n","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/a/src/json.rs","content":"//! Minimal JSON parser/serializer (std-only), sufficient for the HTTP API and\n//! the on-disk metadata files.\n//!\n//! Objects preserve insertion order. Numbers are f64 but the helpers\n//! `as_u64`/`as_i64` extract integers exactly.\n\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::fmt::Write;\n\nuse crate::error::{EngineError, EngineResult};\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub enum Value {\n    Null,\n    Bool(bool),\n    Num(f64),\n    Str(String),\n    Arr(Vec<Value>),\n    /// Insertion-ordered object.\n    Obj(Vec<(String, Value)>),\n}\n\nimpl Value {\n    pub fn obj() -> Self {\n        Value::Obj(Vec::new())\n    }\n\n    pub fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<&Value> {\n        match self {\n            Value::Obj(entries) => entries.iter().find(|(k, _)| k == key).map(|(_, v)| v),\n            _ => None,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn take(&mut self, key: &str) -> Option<Value> {\n        match self {\n            Value::Obj(entries) => {\n                if let Some(pos) = entries.iter().position(|(k, _)| k == key) {\n                    Some(entries.remove(pos).1)\n                } else {\n                    None\n                }\n            }\n            _ => None,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn insert(&mut self, key: &str, val: Value) {\n        if let Value::Obj(entries) = self {\n            if let Some(slot) = entries.iter_mut().find(|(k, _)| k == key) {\n                slot.1 = val;\n                return;\n            }\n            entries.push((key.to_string(), val));\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn as_str(&self) -> Option<&str> {\n        match self {\n            Value::Str(s) => Some(s),\n            _ => None,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn as_u64(&self) -> Option<u64> {\n        match self {\n            Value::Num(n) if n.fract() == 0.0 && *n >= 0.0 => Some(*n as u64),\n            _ => None,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn as_array(&self) -> Option<&Vec<Value>> {\n        match self {\n            Value::Arr(a) => Some(a),\n            _ => None,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn as_object(&self) -> Option<&Vec<(String, Value)>> {\n        match self {\n            Value::Obj(o) => Some(o),\n            _ => None,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn type_name(&self) -> &'static str {\n        match self {\n            Value::Null => \"null\",\n            Value::Bool(_) => \"bool\",\n            Value::Num(_) => \"number\",\n            Value::Str(_) => \"string\",\n            Value::Arr(_) => \"array\",\n            Value::Obj(_) => \"object\",\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Required string field of an object.\n    pub fn req_str(&self, key: &str) -> EngineResult<String> {\n        self.get(key)\n            .and_then(Value::as_str)\n            .map(str::to_string)\n            .ok_or_else(|| EngineError::Invalid(format!(\"missing/invalid string field '{key}'\")))\n    }\n\n    /// Required u64 field.\n    pub fn req_u64(&self, key: &str) -> EngineResult<u64> {\n        self.get(key)\n            .and_then(Value::as_u64)\n            .ok_or_else(|| EngineError::Invalid(format!(\"missing/invalid number field '{key}'\")))\n    }\n}\n\n/// Convenience constructors.\npub fn s(x: impl Into<String>) -> Value {\n    Value::Str(x.into())\n}\npub fn n(x: u64) -> Value {\n    Value::Num(x as f64)\n}\npub fn b(x: bool) -> Value {\n    Value::Bool(x)\n}\n\n// ---------- Parsing ----------\n\npub fn parse(input: &str) -> EngineResult<Value> {\n    let bytes = input.as_bytes();\n    let mut p = Parser { bytes, pos: 0 };\n    p.skip_ws();\n    let v = p.parse_value()?;\n    p.skip_ws();\n    if p.pos != bytes.len() {\n        return Err(EngineError::Json(format!(\n            \"trailing data at byte {}\",\n            p.pos\n        )));\n    }\n    Ok(v)\n}\n\nstruct Parser<'a> {\n    bytes: &'a [u8],\n    pos: usize,\n}\n\nimpl<'a> Parser<'a> {\n    fn skip_ws(&mut self) {\n        while self.pos < self.bytes.len()\n            && matches!(self.bytes[self.pos], b' ' | b'\\t' | b'\\n' | b'\\r')\n        {\n            self.pos += 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn peek(&self) -> Option<u8> {\n        self.bytes.get(self.pos).copied()\n    }\n\n    fn parse_value(&mut self) -> EngineResult<Value> {\n        self.skip_ws();\n        match self.peek() {\n            Some(b'{') => self.parse_object(),\n            Some(b'[') => self.parse_array(),\n            Some(b'\"') => Ok(Value::Str(self.parse_string()?)),\n            Some(b't') | Some(b'f') => self.parse_bool(),\n            Some(b'n') => self.parse_null(),\n            Some(c) if c == b'-' || c.is_ascii_digit() => self.parse_number(),\n            other => Err(EngineError::Json(format!(\n                \"unexpected byte {other:?} at {}\",\n                self.pos\n            ))),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn parse_object(&mut self) -> EngineResult<Value> {\n        self.pos += 1; // {\n        let mut entries = Vec::new();\n        let mut seen = BTreeMap::new();\n        self.skip_ws();\n        if self.peek() == Some(b'}') {\n            self.pos += 1;\n            return Ok(Value::Obj(entries));\n        }\n        loop {\n            self.skip_ws();\n            if self.peek() != Some(b'\"') {\n                return Err(EngineError::Json(format!(\"expected key at {}\", self.pos)));\n            }\n out.push_str(&pad_inner);\n                write_pretty(out, item, indent + 1);\n                if i + 1 < a.len() {\n                    out.push(',');\n                }\n 1);\n                if i + 1 < o.len() {\n                    out.push(',');\n                }\n                out.push('\\n');\n            }\n            out.push_str(&pad);\n Injectable I/O layer.\n//!\n//! All disk traffic in the engine goes through the [`Vfs`] trait instead of\n//! `std::fs` directly, so tests can:\n//!\n//! 1. inject deterministic I/O errors at named *fault points* (fail-once),\n//! 2. use the exact same code on a real filesystem ([`RealVfs`]).\n//!\n//! ## Synchronization boundary\n//!\n//! Durability is provided exclusively by [`Vfs::sync_file`] /\n//! [`Vfs::sync_dir`] after writes, and a crash-safe sequence is always:\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! write temp file in target directory\n//! sync_file(temp)                       // data + inode hit the platter\n//! rename(temp, final)                   // atomic on POSIX\n//! sync_dir(directory)                   // the rename itself is durable\n//! ```\n//!\n//! `RealVfs` maps these to `File::sync_all` and a directory\n//! `open(O_RDONLY)` + `fsync`. Anything performed *before* the final\n//! `sync_dir` may be lost on power loss without violating the engine's\n//! guarantees (stale `*.staging` directories are cleaned on open).\n\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::fs::{self, File, OpenOptions};\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nuse crate::error::{EngineError, EngineResult};\n\n/// Abstract filesystem operations used by the engine.\npub trait Vfs: Send + Sync {\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> bool;\n    fn is_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> bool;\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<Vec<u8>>;\n    fn write(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> EngineResult<()>;\n    fn create_dir_all(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()>;\n    fn list_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<Vec<String>>;\n    fn rename(&self, from: &Path, to: &Path) -> EngineResult<()>;\n    fn remove_file(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()>;\n    fn remove_dir_all(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()>;\n\n    /// fsync a regular file.\n    fn sync_file(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()>;\n    /// fsync a directory (needed to persist rename/unlink on POSIX).\n    fn sync_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()>;\n\n    /// Called by the engine at well-defined points in a multi-step operation.\n    /// `point` names the point; `at` is 1-based occurrence of that point in\n    /// the current operation. The default never fails.\n    fn fault(&self, _point: &str, _at: usize) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n/// Filesystem-backed implementation with real fsync.\npub struct RealVfs;\n\nimpl RealVfs {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        RealVfs\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Default for RealVfs {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        RealVfs\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for RealVfs {\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> bool {\n        path.exists()\n    }\n\n    fn is_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> bool {\n        path.is_dir()\n    }\n\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<Vec<u8>> {\n        let mut f = File::open(path)?;\n        let mut buf = Vec::new();\n        f.read_to_end(&mut buf)?;\n        Ok(buf)\n    }\n\n    fn write(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {\n            fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;\n        }\n        let mut f = OpenOptions::new()\n            .write(true)\n            .create(true)\n            .truncate(true)\n            .open(path)?;\n        f.write_all(data)?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn create_dir_all(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        fs::create_dir_all(path)?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn list_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<Vec<String>> {\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        if !path.exists() {\n            return Ok(out);\n        }\n        for entry in fs::read_dir(path)? {\n            let entry = entry?;\n            if let Some(name) = entry.file_name().to_str() {\n                out.push(name.to_string());\n            }\n        }\n        out.sort();\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &Path, to: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        fs::rename(from, to)?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn remove_file(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        match fs::remove_file(path) {\n            Ok(()) => Ok(()),\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(()),\n            Err(e) => Err(e.into()),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn remove_dir_all(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        match fs::remove_dir_all(path) {\n            Ok(()) => Ok(()),\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(()),\n            Err(e) => Err(e.into()),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn sync_file(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        let f = File::open(path)?;\n        f.sync_all()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    #[cfg(unix)]\n    fn sync_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;\n        let f = OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .custom_flags(libc_O_RDONLY())\n            .open(path)?;\n        f.sync_all()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    #[cfg(not(unix))]\n    fn sync_dir(&self, _path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        // Directory fsync is not exposed on non-POSIX; durability of the\n        // rename entry is best-effort there.\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(unix)]\nfn libc_O_RDONLY() -> i32 {\n    0 // O_RDONLY is 0 on all supported Unix targets\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Fault injection\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// What happens when a fault rule fires.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum FaultAction {\n    /// Return an I/O error at the named fault point (process stays alive).\n    FailPoint,\n    /// Corrupt one byte at `byte_offset` (from the end when negative) of every\n    /// payload written via `write`.\n    CorruptWrite { byte_offset: i64, xor: u8 },\n}\n\n/// A one-shot deterministic fault rule.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct FaultRule {\n    /// Fault point name, e.g. \"merge.commit\".\n    pub point: String,\n    /// 1-based occurrence; `at == 1` fires the first time the point is hit.\n    pub at: usize,\n    pub action: FaultAction,\n}\n\n/// Shared, mutable fault configuration wrapped around any [`Vfs`].\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub struct InjectVfs {\n    inner: Arc<dyn Vfs>,\n    state: Arc<Mutex<InjectState>>,\n}\n\nstruct InjectState {\n    rules: HashMap<String, FaultRule>,\n    hits: HashMap<String, usize>,\n    fired: Vec<String>,\n}\n\nimpl InjectVfs {\n    pub fn new(inner: Arc<dyn Vfs>) -> Self {\n        InjectVfs {\n            inner,\n            state: Arc::new(Mutex::new(InjectState {\n                rules: HashMap::new(),\n                hits: HashMap::new(),\n                fired: Vec::new(),\n            })),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Install (or replace) a one-shot rule.\n    pub fn set_rule(&self, rule: FaultRule) {\n        let mut st = self.state.lock().unwrap();\n        st.hits.insert(rule.point.clone(), 0);\n        st.rules.insert(rule.point.clone(), rule);\n    }\n\n    pub fn clear_rules(&self) {\n        let mut st = self.state.lock().unwrap();\n        st.rules.clear();\n        st.hits.clear();\n        st.fired.clear();\n    }\n\n    pub fn fired(&self) -> Vec<String> {\n        self.state.lock().unwrap().fired.clone()\n    }\n\n    fn check_point(&self, point: &str) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        let mut st = self.state.lock().unwrap();\n        if let Some(rule) = st.rules.get(point).cloned() {\n            let count = st.hits.entry(point.to_string()).or_insert(0);\n            *count += 1;\n            let at = rule.at.max(1);\n            if *count == at {\n                st.rules.remove(point);\n                st.fired.push(point.to_string());\n                drop(st);\n                return Err(EngineError::Injected(format!(\n                    \"fault point '{point}' fired on occurrence {at}\"\n                )));\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn maybe_corrupt(&self, data: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {\n        let st = self.state.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut out: Option<Vec<u8>> = None;\n        for rule in st.rules.values() {\n            if let FaultAction::CorruptWrite { byte_offset, xor } = rule.action {\n                if data.is_empty() {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                let idx = if byte_offset >= 0 {\n                    let idx = byte_offset as usize;\n                    if idx >= data.len() {\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                    idx\n                } else {\n                    let back = (-byte_offset) as usize;\n                    if back > data.len() {\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                    data.len() - back\n                };\n                let buf = out.get_or_insert_with(|| data.to_vec());\n                buf[idx] ^= xor;\n            }\n        }\n        out.unwrap_or_else(|| data.to_vec())\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for InjectVfs {\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> bool {\n        self.inner.exists(path)\n    }\n    fn is_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> bool {\n        self.inner.is_dir(path)\n    }\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<Vec<u8>> {\n        self.inner.read(path)\n    }\n    fn write(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        let data = self.maybe_corrupt(data);\n        self.inner.write(path, &data)\n    }\n    fn create_dir_all(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        self.inner.create_dir_all(path)\n    }\n    fn list_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<Vec<String>> {\n        self.inner.list_dir(path)\n    }\n    fn rename(&self, from: &Path, to: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        self.inner.rename(from, to)\n    }\n    fn remove_file(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        self.inner.remove_file(path)\n    }\n    fn remove_dir_all(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        self.inner.remove_dir_all(path)\n    }\n    fn sync_file(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        self.inner.sync_file(path)\n    }\n    fn sync_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        self.inner.sync_dir(path)\n    }\n    fn fault(&self, point: &str, at: usize) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        // Also let the inner layer see it (no-op for RealVfs).\n        self.inner.fault(point, at)?;\n        self.check_point(point)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Helper for tests: build a real-fs-backed injecting VFS rooted anywhere.\npub fn real_injecting() -> InjectVfs {\n    InjectVfs::new(Arc::new(RealVfs::new()))\n}\n\n/// Unique temp file suffix within a process.\npub fn unique_tmp_tag() -> String {\n    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\n    static COUNTER: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);\n    let n = COUNTER.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);\n    let pid = std::process::id();\n    format!(\"{pid}-{n}\")\n}\n\n#[allow(dead_code)]\nfn All disk traffic in the engine goes through the [`Vfs`] trait instead of\n//! `std::fs` directly, so tests can:\n//!\n//! 1. inject deterministic I/O errors at named *fault points* (fail-once),\n//! 2. use the exact same code on a real filesystem ([`RealVfs`]).\n//!\n//! ## Synchronization boundary\n//!\n//! Durability is provided exclusively by [`Vfs::sync_file`] /\n//! [`Vfs::sync_dir`] after writes, and a crash-safe sequence is always:\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! write temp file in target directory\n//! sync_file(temp)                       // data + inode hit the platter\n//! rename(temp, final)                   // atomic on POSIX\n//! sync_dir(directory)                   // the rename itself is durable\n//! ```\n//!\n//! `RealVfs` maps these to `File::sync_all` and a directory\n//! `open(O_RDONLY)` + `fsync`. Anything performed *before* the final\n//! `sync_dir` may be lost on power loss without violating the engine's\n//! guarantees (stale `*.staging` directories are cleaned on open).\n\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::fs::{self, File, OpenOptions};\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nuse crate::error::{EngineError, EngineResult};\n\n/// Abstract filesystem operations used by the engine.\npub trait Vfs: Send + Sync {\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> bool;\n    fn is_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> bool;\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<Vec<u8>>;\n    fn write(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> EngineResult<()>;\n    fn create_dir_all(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()>;\n    fn list_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<Vec<String>>;\n    fn rename(&self, from: &Path, to: &Path) -> EngineResult<()>;\n    fn remove_file(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()>;\n    fn remove_dir_all(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()>;\n\n    /// fsync a regular file.\n    fn sync_file(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()>;\n    /// fsync a directory (needed to persist rename/unlink on POSIX).\n    fn sync_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()>;\n\n    /// Called by the engine at well-defined points in a multi-step operation.\n    /// `point` names the point; `at` is 1-based occurrence of that point in\n    /// the current operation. The default never fails.\n    fn fault(&self, _point: &str, _at: usize) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n/// Filesystem-backed implementation with real fsync.\npub struct RealVfs;\n\nimpl RealVfs {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        RealVfs\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Default for RealVfs {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        RealVfs\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for RealVfs {\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> bool {\n        path.exists()\n    }\n\n    fn is_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> bool {\n        path.is_dir()\n    }\n\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<Vec<u8>> {\n        let mut f = File::open(path)?;\n        let mut buf = Vec::new();\n        f.read_to_end(&mut buf)?;\n        Ok(buf)\n    }\n\n    fn write(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {\n            fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;\n        }\n        let mut f = OpenOptions::new()\n            .write(true)\n            .create(true)\n            .truncate(true)\n            .open(path)?;\n        f.write_all(data)?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn create_dir_all(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        fs::create_dir_all(path)?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn list_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<Vec<String>> {\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        if !path.exists() {\n            return Ok(out);\n        }\n        for entry in fs::read_dir(path)? {\n            let entry = entry?;\n            if let Some(name) = entry.file_name().to_str() {\n                out.push(name.to_string());\n            }\n        }\n        out.sort();\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &Path, to: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        fs::rename(from, to)?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn remove_file(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        match fs::remove_file(path) {\n            Ok(()) => Ok(()),\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(()),\n            Err(e) => Err(e.into()),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn remove_dir_all(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        match fs::remove_dir_all(path) {\n            Ok(()) => Ok(()),\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(()),\n            Err(e) => Err(e.into()),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn sync_file(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        let f = File::open(path)?;\n        f.sync_all()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    #[cfg(unix)]\n    fn sync_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;\n        let f = OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .custom_flags(libc_O_RDONLY())\n            .open(path)?;\n        f.sync_all()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    #[cfg(not(unix))]\n    fn sync_dir(&self, _path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        // Directory fsync is not exposed on non-POSIX; durability of the\n        // rename entry is best-effort there.\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(unix)]\nfn libc_O_RDONLY() -> i32 {\n    0 // O_RDONLY is 0 on all supported Unix targets\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Fault injection\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// What happens when a fault rule fires.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum FaultAction {\n    /// Return an I/O error at the named fault point (process stays alive).\n    FailPoint,\n    /// Corrupt one byte at `byte_offset` (from the end when negative) of every\n    /// payload written via `write`.\n    CorruptWrite { byte_offset: i64, xor: u8 },\n}\n\n/// A one-shot deterministic fault rule.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct FaultRule {\n    /// Fault point name, e.g. \"merge.commit\".\n    pub point: String,\n    /// 1-based occurrence; `at == 1` fires the first time the point is hit.\n    pub at: usize,\n    pub action: FaultAction,\n}\n\n/// Shared, mutable fault configuration wrapped around any [`Vfs`].\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub struct InjectVfs {\n    inner: Arc<dyn Vfs>,\n    state: Arc<Mutex<InjectState>>,\n}\n\nstruct InjectState {\n    rules: HashMap<String, FaultRule>,\n    hits: HashMap<String, usize>,\n    fired: Vec<String>,\n}\n\nimpl InjectVfs {\n    pub fn new(inner: Arc<dyn Vfs>) -> Self {\n        InjectVfs {\n            inner,\n            state: Arc::new(Mutex::new(InjectState {\n                rules: HashMap::new(),\n                hits: HashMap::new(),\n                fired: Vec::new(),\n            })),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Install (or replace) a one-shot rule.\n    pub fn set_rule(&self, rule: FaultRule) {\n        let mut st = self.state.lock().unwrap();\n        st.hits.insert(rule.point.clone(), 0);\n        st.rules.insert(rule.point.clone(), rule);\n    }\n\n    pub fn clear_rules(&self) {\n        let mut st = self.state.lock().unwrap();\n        st.rules.clear();\n        st.hits.clear();\n        st.fired.clear();\n    }\n\n    pub fn fired(&self) -> Vec<String> {\n        self.state.lock().unwrap().fired.clone()\n    }\n\n    fn check_point(&self, point: &str) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        let mut st = self.state.lock().unwrap();\n        if let Some(rule) = st.rules.get(point).cloned() {\n            let count = st.hits.entry(point.to_string()).or_insert(0);\n            *count += 1;\n            let at = rule.at.max(1);\n            if *count == at {\n                st.rules.remove(point);\n                st.fired.push(point.to_string());\n                drop(st);\n                return Err(EngineError::Injected(format!(\n                    \"fault point '{point}' fired on occurrence {at}\"\n                )));\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn maybe_corrupt(&self, data: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {\n        let st = self.state.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut out: Option<Vec<u8>> = None;\n        for rule in st.rules.values() {\n            if let FaultAction::CorruptWrite { byte_offset, xor } = rule.action {\n                if data.is_empty() {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                let idx = if byte_offset >= 0 {\n                    let idx = byte_offset as usize;\n                    if idx >= data.len() {\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                    idx\n                } else {\n                    let back = (-byte_offset) as usize;\n                    if back > data.len() {\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                    data.len() - back\n                };\n                let buf = out.get_or_insert_with(|| data.to_vec());\n                buf[idx] ^= xor;\n            }\n        }\n        out.unwrap_or_else(|| data.to_vec())\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for InjectVfs {\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> bool {\n        self.inner.exists(path)\n    }\n    fn is_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> bool {\n        self.inner.is_dir(path)\n    }\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<Vec<u8>> {\n        self.inner.read(path)\n    }\n    fn write(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        let data = self.maybe_corrupt(data);\n        self.inner.write(path, &data)\n    }\n    fn create_dir_all(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        self.inner.create_dir_all(path)\n    }\n    fn list_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<Vec<String>> {\n        self.inner.list_dir(path)\n    }\n    fn rename(&self, from: &Path, to: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        self.inner.rename(from, to)\n    }\n    fn remove_file(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        self.inner.remove_file(path)\n    }\n    fn remove_dir_all(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        self.inner.remove_dir_all(path)\n    }\n    fn sync_file(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        self.inner.sync_file(path)\n    }\n    fn sync_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        self.inner.sync_dir(path)\n    }\n    fn fault(&self, point: &str, at: usize) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        // Also let the inner layer see it (no-op for RealVfs).\n        self.inner.fault(point, at)?;\n        self.check_point(point)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Helper for tests: build a real-fs-backed injecting VFS rooted anywhere.\npub fn real_injecting() -> InjectVfs {\n    InjectVfs::new(Arc::new(RealVfs::new()))\n}\n\n/// Unique temp file suffix within a process.\npub fn unique_tmp_tag() -> String {\n    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\n    static COUNTER: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);\n    let n = COUNTER.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);\n    let pid = std::process::id();\n    format!(\"{pid}-{n}\")\n}\n\n#[allow(dead_code)]\nfn File-backed storage repository: fixed-page datasets, full/incremental\n//! checkpoints, strict dependency-chain recovery and checkpoint merging.\n//!\n//! ## On-disk layout\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! <root>/\n//!   datasets/\n//!     <name>/\n//!       dataset.json                 # immutable dataset descriptor\n//!       state.json                  # mutable: current tip + next checkpoint id\n//!       pages/\n//!         p<idx>                    # one working page per file (see below)\n//!       checkpoints/\n//!         <id>.json                 # checkpoint metadata\n//!         <id>.data                 # concatenated fixed-size page payloads\n//!         cp-<id>.staging/          # crash leftovers; removed on open\n//! ```\n//!\n//! Page file (`pages/p<idx>`) binary layout, all integers big-endian:\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! offset 0  magic   \"ICEPG01\\n\"          (8 bytes)\n//! offset 8  version u32                  monotonic per-page, starts at 1\n//! offset 12 crc32  u32                  CRC-32 of the payload\n//! offset 16 page_size u32               must equal dataset.page_size\n//! offset 20 payload <page_size bytes>\n//! ```\n//!\n//! Checkpoint metadata `<id>.json` (pretty JSON):\n//!\n//! ```json\n//! {\n//!   \"id\": 2,\n//!   \"kind\": \"incremental\",            // or \"full\"\n//!   \"parent\": 1,                      // null for full checkpoints\n//!   \"created_at_unix\": 1727000000,\n//!   \"page_size\": 64,\n//!   \"page_count\": 8,\n//!   \"data_crc\": \"8f12e3aa\",           // CRC-32 of the whole .data file\n//!   \"pages\": [\n//!     {\"page\": 3, \"version\": 2, \"crc\": \"1b2a90ef\"}\n//!   ]\n//! }\n//! ```\n//!\n//! `<id>.data` is the concatenation, in ascending `page` order, of each\n//! listed page's raw `page_size` payload. `data_crc` covers the whole file and\n//! every entry additionally carries its own per-page CRC. Both are verified\n//! before a checkpoint participates in recovery or merge.\n\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\nuse std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};\n\nuse crate::crc32::crc32_hex;\nuse crate::error::{EngineError, EngineResult};\nuse crate::json::{self, s, Value};\nuse crate::vfs::{unique_tmp_tag, Vfs};\n\nconst MAGIC: &[u8; 8] = b\"ICEPG01\\n\";\nconst HEADER_LEN: usize = 20;\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Public types\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum CpKind {\n    Full,\n    Incremental,\n}\n\nimpl CpKind {\n    fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {\n        match self {\n            CpKind::Full => \"full\",\n            CpKind::Incremental => \"incremental\",\n        }\n    }\n    fn parse(x: &str) -> EngineResult<CpKind> {\n        match x {\n            \"full\" => Ok(CpKind::Full),\n            \"incremental\" => Ok(CpKind::Incremental),\n            other => Err(EngineError::Corrupt(format!(\"unknown checkpoint kind '{other}'\"))),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct PageEntry {\n    pub page: u32,\n    pub version: u64,\n    pub crc: String,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct CpMeta {\n    pub id: u64,\n    pub kind: CpKind,\n    pub parent: Option<u64>,\n    pub created_at_unix: u64,\n    pub page_size: u32,\n    pub page_count: u32,\n    pub data_crc: String,\n    pub pages: Vec<PageEntry>,\n}\n\n/// A fully loaded and verified checkpoint: payloads are aligned 1:1 with\n/// `meta.pages`.\npub struct LoadedCp {\n    pub meta: CpMeta,\n    pub payloads: Vec<Vec<u8>>,\n}\n\n/// One page as resolved at the tip of a dependency chain.\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub struct ResolvedPage {\n    pub version: u64,\n    pub crc: String,\n    pub payload: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\n/// Result of walking a dependency chain.\npub struct Resolved {\n    /// Checkpoint ids from the chain root (a full checkpoint) to the target.\n    pub chain: Vec<u64>,\n    pub pages: BTreeMap<u32, ResolvedPage>,\n}\n\n/// Summary row for digest responses.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct PageDigest {\n    pub page: u32,\n    pub version: u64,\n    pub source: Option<u64>,\n    pub crc: String,\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub struct WorkingPage {\n    pub version: u64,\n    pub payload: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Repository / dataset handles\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\npub struct Repository {\n    root: PathBuf,\n    vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs>,\n}\n\nimpl Repository {\n    /// Open (or initialize) a repository rooted at `root`.\n    pub fn open(root: impl Into<PathBuf>, vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs>) -> EngineResult<Arc<Self>> {\n        let root = root.into();\n        vfs.create_dir_all(root.join(\"datasets\"))?;\n        Ok(Arc::new(Repository { root, vfs }))\n    }\n\n    pub fn vfs(&self) -> &Arc<dyn Vfs> {\n        &self.vfs\n    }\n\n    fn datasets_dir(&self) -> PathBuf {\n        self.root.join(\"datasets\")\n    }\n\n    pub fn list_datasets(self: &Arc<Self>) -> EngineResult<Vec<String>> {\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        for name in self.vfs.list_dir(&self.datasets_dir())? {\n            if self.vfs.is_dir(&self.datasets_dir().join(&name)) {\n                out.push(name);\n            }\n        }\n        out.sort();\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n\n    /// Create a fixed-page dataset.\n    pub fn create_dataset(\n        self: &Arc<Self>,\n        name: &str,\n        page_size: u32,\n        page_count: u32,\n    ) -> EngineResult<Arc<Dataset>> {\n        validate_name(name)?;\n        if !(1..=1 << 20).contains(&page_size) {\n            return Err(EngineError::Invalid(\n                \"page_size must be between 1 and 1048576\".into(),\n            ));\n        }\n        if page_count == 0 {\n            return Err(EngineError::Invalid(\"page_count must be >= 1\".into()));\n        }\n        let dir = self.datasets_dir().join(name);\n        if self.vfs.exists(&dir) {\n            return Err(EngineError::DatasetExists(name.into()));\n        }\n        self.vfs.create_dir_all(dir.join(\"pages\"))?;\n        self.vfs.create_dir_all(dir.join(\"checkpoints\"))?;\n\n        let desc = DatasetDesc {\n            name: name.to_string(),\n            page_size,\n            page_count,\n        };\n        atomic_write(\n            &*self.vfs,\n            &dir.join(\"dataset.json\"),\n            json::stringify_pretty(&desc.to_json()).as_bytes(),\n        )?;\n        let state = DsState { tip: None, next_id: 1 };\n        atomic_write(\n            &*self.vfs,\n            &dir.join(\"state.json\"),\n            json::stringify_pretty(&state.to_json()).as_bytes(),\n        )?;\n        self.sync_dataset_dir(&dir)?;\n        self.open_dataset(name)\n    }\n\n    pub fn open_dataset(self: &Arc<Self>, name: &str) -> EngineResult<Arc<Dataset>> {\n        validate_name(name)?;\n        let dir = self.datasets_dir().join(name);\n        if !self.vfs.is_dir(&dir) {\n            return Err(EngineError::DatasetNotFound(name.into()));\n        }\n        let desc_raw = self\n            .vfs\n            .read(&dir.join(\"dataset.json\"))\n            .map_err(|_| EngineError::Corrupt(format!(\"dataset.json missing for '{name}'\")))?;\n        let desc = DatasetDesc::from_json(&json::parse(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&desc_raw))?)?;\n\n        // Crash leftovers: staging directories and hidden temp files.\n        cleanup_stale(&*self.vfs, &dir)?;\n\n        let state = self.load_state(&dir)?;\n\n        // Reconcile next_id against what is actually on disk so an id is never\n        // reused even if state.json was lost mid-commit.\n        let max_id = scan_checkpoint_ids(&*self.vfs, &dir.join(\"checkpoints\"))?\n            .into_iter()\n            .max()\n            .unwrap_or(0);\n        let next_id = state.next_id.max(max_id + 1);\n        let tip = match state.tip {\n            Some(id) if self.vfs.exists(&cp_meta_path(&dir, id)) => Some(id),\n            _ => None,\n        };\n        if tip != state.tip || next_id != state.next_id {\n            let fixed = DsState { tip, next_id };\n            atomic_write(\n                &*self.vfs,\n                &dir.join(\"state.json\"),\n                json::stringify_pretty(&fixed.to_json()).as_bytes(),\n            )?;\n        }\n\n        Ok(Arc::new(Dataset {\n            repo: self.clone(),\n            dir,\n            desc,\n            lock: Mutex::new(()),\n            state: Mutex::new(DsState { tip, next_id }),\n        }))\n    }\n\n    fn load_state(&self, dir: &Path) -> EngineResult<DsState> {\n        let path = dir.join(\"state.json\");\n        let raw = if self.vfs.exists(&path) {\n            self.vfs.read(&path)?\n        } else {\n            // Missing state: rebuild from scratch.\n            return Ok(DsState { tip: None, next_id: 1 });\n        };\n        DsState::from_json(&json::parse(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw))?)\n    }\n\n    fn sync_dataset_dir(&self, dir: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        self.vfs.sync_dir(dir)?;\n        self.vfs.sync_dir(&dir.join(\"pages\"))?;\n        self.vfs.sync_dir(&dir.join(\"checkpoints\"))?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\npub struct Dataset {\n    repo: Arc<Repository>,\n    dir: PathBuf,\n    desc: DatasetDesc,\n    /// Serializes all mutating multi-step operations.\n    lock: Mutex<()>,\n    state: Mutex<DsState>,\n}\n\nimpl Dataset {\n    pub fn name(&self) -> &str {\n        &self.desc.name\n    }\n    pub fn page_size(&self) -> u32 {\n        self.desc.page_size\n    }\n    pub fn page_count(&self) -> u32 {\n        self.desc.page_count\n    }\n    pub fn tip(&self) -> Option<u64> {\n        self.state.lock().unwrap().tip\n    }\n\n    fn vfs(&self) -> &dyn Vfs {\n        self.repo.vfs.as_ref()\n    }\n\n    fn pages_dir(&self) -> PathBuf {\n        self.dir.join(\"pages\")\n    }\n    fn cp_dir(&self) -> PathBuf {\n        self.dir.join(\"checkpoints\")\n    }\n\n    // -- working pages -----------------------------------------------------\n\n    /// Read all working pages currently present on disk (unwritten pages are\n    /// implicit zero pages and not included).\n    fn load_working(&self) -> EngineResult<BTreeMap<u32, WorkingPage>> {\n        let mut map = BTreeMap::new();\n        for entry in self.vfs().list_dir(&self.pages_dir())? {\n            let Some(idx_str) = entry.strip_prefix('p') else {\n                continue; // hidden temp files etc.\n            };\n            let Ok(idx) = idx_str.parse::<u32>() else {\n                continue;\n            };\n            if idx >= self.desc.page_count {\n                return Err(EngineError::Corrupt(format!(\n                    \"page file {entry} out of range\"\n                )));\n            }\n            let raw = self.vfs().read(&self.pages_dir().join(&entry))?;\n            let (version, payload) = decode_page_file(&raw, self.desc.page_size)?;\n            map.insert(idx, WorkingPage { version, payload });\n        }\n        Ok(map)\n    }\n\n    /// Write a page. Content-equal writes are a no-op (no version bump).\n    /// Returns the new (or current) page version and whether it changed.\n    pub fn write_page(&self, page: u32, data: &[u8]) -> EngineResult<(u64, bool)> {\n        if page >= self.desc.page_count {\n            return Err(EngineError::Invalid(format!(\n                \"page {page} out of range 0..{}\",\n                self.desc.page_count\n            )));\n        }\n        if data.len() as u32 != self.desc.page_size {\n            return Err(EngineError::Invalid(format!(\n                \"payload must be exactly {} bytes, got {}\",\n                self.desc.page_size,\n                data.len()\n            )));\n        }\n        let _g = self.lock.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut working = self.load_working()?;\n        let current = working.remove(&page);\n        let (version, changed) = match &current {\n            Some(wp) if wp.payload == data => (wp.version, false),\n            Some(wp) => (wp.version + 1, true),\n            None => {\n                // Unwritten page is the zero page.\n                let zero = vec![0u8; self.desc.page_size as usize];\n                if zero == data {\n                    (0, false)\n                } else {\n                    (1, true)\n                }\n            }\n        };\n        if changed {\n            let path = self.pages_dir().join(format!(\"p{page}\"));\n            let raw = encode_page_file(version, self.desc.page_size, data);\n            atomic_write(self.vfs(), &path, &raw)?;\n            self.vfs().fault(\"page.write\", 1)?;\n        }\n        Ok((version, changed))\n    }\n\n    /// Read one working page; unwritten pages come back as zero bytes version 0.\n    pub fn read_page(&self, page: u32) -> EngineResult<(u64, Vec<u8>)> {\n        if page >= self.desc.page_count {\n            return Err(EngineError::Invalid(format!(\n                \"page {page} out of range\"\n            )));\n        }\n        let path = self.pages_dir().join(format!(\"p{page}\"));\n        if self.vfs().exists(&path) {\n            let raw = self.vfs().read(&path)?;\n            Ok(decode_page_file(&raw, self.desc.page_size)?)\n        } else {\n            Ok((0, vec![0u8; self.desc.page_size as usize]))\n        }\n    }\n\n    // -- checkpoints -------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /// Create a checkpoint.\n    /// * `full == true`  -> parent ignored; every page is recorded.\n    /// * `full == false` -> parent defaults to the current tip; the delta to\n    ///   the parent's final content is recorded.\n    pub fn checkpoint(&self, full: bool, parent: Option<u64>) -> EngineResult<u64> {\n        let _g = self.lock.lock().unwrap();\n        let working = self.load_working()?;\n        let state = *self.state.lock().unwrap();\n        let id = state.next_id;\n\n        let (kind, parent_id, base_pages): (CpKind, Option<u64>, BTreeMap<u32, ResolvedPage>) =\n            if full {\n                (CpKind::Full, None, BTreeMap::new())\n            } else {\n                let pid = parent.or(state.tip).ok_or_else(|| {\n                    EngineError::Invalid(\n                        \"cannot create incremental checkpoint without a parent\".into(),\n                    )\n                })?;\n                let resolved = self.resolve(pid)?;\n                (CpKind::Incremental, Some(pid), resolved.pages)\n            };\n\n        // Build the page entry list.\n        let mut entries: Vec<PageEntry> = Vec::new();\n        let mut data = Vec::new();\n        for idx in 0..self.desc.page_count {\n            let bytes = working_page_bytes(&working, idx, self.desc.page_size);\n            let include = match kind {\n                CpKind::Full => true,\n                CpKind::Incremental => match base_pages.get(&idx) {\n                    Some(base) => base.payload != bytes,\n                    None => true,\n                },\n            };\n            if include {\n                let version = working.get(&idx).map(|w| w.version).unwrap_or(0);\n                entries.push(PageEntry {\n                    page: idx,\n                    version,\n                    crc: crc32_hex(bytes),\n                });\n                data.extend_from_slice(bytes);\n            }\n        }\n\n        let meta = CpMeta {\n            id,\n            kind,\n            parent: parent_id,\n            created_at_unix: unix_now(),\n            page_size: self.desc.page_size,\n            page_count: self.desc.page_count,\n            data_crc: crc32_hex(&data),\n            pages: entries,\n        };\n        self.commit_checkpoint(&meta, &data, \"checkpoint\")?;\n\n        let new_state = DsState {\n            tip: Some(id),\n            next_id: id + 1,\n        };\n        self.persist_state(&new_state)?;\n        Ok(id)\n    }\n\n    /// Stage files under a unique staging dir, fsync, atomically rename into\n    /// place, fsync the parent directory.\n    fn commit_checkpoint(&self, meta: &CpMeta, data: &[u8], point_prefix: &str)\n        -> EngineResult<()> {\n        let cp_dir = self.cp_dir();\n        let staging = cp_dir.join(format!(\"cp-{}.staging.{}\", meta.id, unique_tmp_tag()));\n        self.vfs().create_dir_all(&staging)?;\n\n        self.vfs()\n            .fault(&format!(\"{point_prefix}.write\"), 1)?;\n\n        atomic_write_raw(\n            self.vfs(),\n            &staging.join(format!(\"{}.data\", meta.id)),\n            data,\n        )?;\n        atomic_write_raw(\n            self.vfs(),\n            &staging.join(format!(\"{}.json\", meta.id)),\n            json::stringify_pretty(&meta.to_json()).as_bytes(),\n        )?;\n\n        // Drop the staging wrapper dir: files move directly into checkpoints/.\n        let final_meta = cp_meta_path(&self.dir, meta.id);\n        let final_data = cp_data_path(&self.dir, meta.id);\n\n        self.vfs()\n            .fault(&format!(\"{point_prefix}.commit\"), 1)?;\n\n        self.vfs()\n            .rename(&staging.join(format!(\"{}.data\", meta.id)), &final_data)?;\n        self.vfs()\n            .rename(&staging.join(format!(\"{}.json\", meta.id)), &final_meta)?;\n        self.vfs().sync_dir(&cp_dir)?;\n        // Staging dir is empty now; remove best-effort.\n        let _ = self.vfs().remove_dir_all(&staging);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn persist_state(&self, new_state: &DsState) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        atomic_write(\n            self.vfs(),\n            &self.dir.join(\"state.json\"),\n            json::stringify_pretty(&new_state.to_json()).as_bytes(),\n        )?;\n        *self.state.lock().unwrap() = *new_state;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// List checkpoints (id, kind, parent), sorted by id.\n    pub fn list_checkpoints(&self) -> EngineResult<Vec<CpMeta>> {\n        let mut metas = Vec::new();\n        for id in scan_checkpoint_ids(self.vfs(), &self.cp_dir())? {\n            metas.push(self.load_meta(id)?);\n        }\n        Ok(metas)\n    }\n\n    fn load_meta(&self, id: u64) -> EngineResult<CpMeta> {\n        let raw = self.vfs().read(&cp_meta_path(&self.dir, id))?;\n        let v = json::parse(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw))?;\n        CpMeta::from_json(&v)\n    }\n\n    /// Load metadata + data file and verify every checksum.\n    fn load_checkpoint(&self, id: u64) -> EngineResult<LoadedCp> {\n        let meta = self.load_meta(id)?;\n        if meta.page_size != self.desc.page_size || meta.page_count != self.desc.page_count {\n            return Err(EngineError::Corrupt(format!(\n                \"checkpoint {id} geometry ({},{}) does not match dataset ({},{})\",\n                meta.page_size, meta.page_count, self.desc.page_size, self.desc.page_count\n            )));\n        }\n        let data_path = cp_data_path(&self.dir, id);\n        let exists = self.vfs().exists(&data_path);\n        let data = if exists {\n            self.vfs().read(&data_path)?\n        } else {\n            Vec::new()\n        };\n        let expected_len = meta.pages.len() as u64 * meta.page_size as u64;\n        if data.len() as u64 != expected_len {\n            return Err(EngineError::Corrupt(format!(\n                \"checkpoint {id} data file length {} != expected {expected_len}\",\n                data.len()\n            )));\n        }\n        if crc32_hex(&data) != meta.data_crc {\n            return Err(EngineError::ChecksumMismatch {\n                expected: meta.data_crc.clone(),\n                actual: crc32_hex(&data),\n            });\n        }\n        let mut payloads = Vec::with_capacity(meta.pages.len());\n        let mut cursor = 0usize;\n        for entry in &meta.pages {\n            let chunk = &data[cursor..cursor + meta.page_size as usize];\n            cursor += meta.page_size as usize;\n            let actual = crc32_hex(chunk);\n            if actual != entry.crc {\n                return Err(EngineError::ChecksumMismatch {\n                    expected: entry.crc.clone(),\n                    actual,\n                });\n            }\n            payloads.push(chunk.to_vec());\n        }\n        Ok(LoadedCp { meta, payloads })\n    }\n\n    // -- dependency-chain walk ---------------------------------------------\n\n    /// Strictly walk the dependency chain of `target`, verifying every\n    /// checkpoint and overlaying pages root-first.\n    ///\n    /// Errors:\n    /// * [`EngineError::CheckpointNotFound`] if the target does not exist,\n    /// * [`EngineError::MissingParent`] if a referenced parent file is absent,\n    /// * [`EngineError::Cycle`] if following parents revisits an id,\n    /// * [`EngineError::ChecksumMismatch`] / [`EngineError::Corrupt`] on\n    ///   malformed or corrupted checkpoint content.\n    pub fn resolve(&self, target: u64) -> EngineResult<Resolved> {\n        // Collect the raw parent chain target -> root, with cycle detection.\n        let mut reverse_chain: Vec<u64> = Vec::new();\n        let mut on_path = std::collections::HashSet::new();\n        let mut cur = Some(target);\n        while let Some(id) = cur {\n            if !self.vfs().exists(&cp_meta_path(&self.dir, id)) {\n                return if reverse_chain.is_empty() {\n                    Err(EngineError::CheckpointNotFound(id.to_string()))\n                } else {\n                    let child = *reverse_chain.last().unwrap();\n                    Err(EngineError::MissingParent {\n                        id: child.to_string(),\n                        parent: id.to_string(),\n                    })\n                };\n            }\n            if !on_path.insert(id) {\n                return Err(EngineError::Cycle(id.to_string()));\n            }\n            let meta = self.load_meta(id)?;\n            reverse_chain.push(id);\n            cur = match meta.kind {\n                CpKind::Full => {\n                    if meta.parent.is_some() {\n                        return Err(EngineError::Corrupt(format!(\n                            \"full checkpoint {id} must not have a parent\"\n                        )));\n                    }\n                    None\n                }\n                CpKind::Incremental => {\n                    let p = meta.parent.ok_or_else(|| {\n                        EngineError::Corrupt(format!(\n                            \"incremental checkpoint {id} has no parent\"\n                        ))\n                    })?;\n                    Some(p)\n                }\n            };\n        }\n\n        let chain: Vec<u64> = reverse_chain.into_iter().rev().collect();\n        let mut pages: BTreeMap<u32, ResolvedPage> = BTreeMap::new();\n        for (pos, &id) in chain.iter().enumerate() {\n            let loaded = self.load_checkpoint(id)?;\n            let is_root = pos == 0;\n            if loaded.meta.kind == CpKind::Full {\n                if !is_root {\n                    return Err(EngineError::Corrupt(format!(\n                        \"full checkpoint {id} found mid-chain\"\n                    )));\n                }\n                if loaded.meta.pages.len() as u32 != self.desc.page_count {\n                    return Err(EngineError::Corrupt(format!(\n                        \"full checkpoint {id} does not cover every page\"\n                    )));\n                }\n                pages.clear();\n            }\n            let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();\n            for (entry, payload) in loaded.meta.pages.iter().zip(loaded.payloads.iter()) {\n                if entry.page >= self.desc.page_count {\n                    return Err(EngineError::Corrupt(format!(\n                        \"checkpoint {id} references out-of-range page {}\",\n                        entry.page\n                    )));\n                }\n                if !seen.insert(entry.page) {\n                    return Err(EngineError::Corrupt(format!(\n                        \"checkpoint {id} lists page {} twice\",\n                        entry.page\n                    )));\n                }\n                pages.insert(\n                    entry.page,\n                    ResolvedPage {\n                        version: entry.version,\n                        crc: entry.crc.clone(),\n                        payload: payload.clone(),\n                    },\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        if pages.len() as u32 != self.desc.page_count {\n            return Err(EngineError::Corrupt(format!(\n                \"chain for {target} resolves {} pages, expected {}\",\n                pages.len(),\n                self.desc.page_count\n            )));\n        }\n        Ok(Resolved { chain, pages })\n    }\n\n    /// Apply a checkpoint along its dependency chain into the working set and\n    /// set it as the tip. Every page is rewritten atomically; page files whose\n    /// content is unchanged are left alone.\n    pub fn restore(&self, target: u64) -> EngineResult<Vec<u64>> {\n        let _g = self.lock.lock().unwrap();\n        let resolved = self.resolve(target)?;\n        let working = self.load_working()?;\n\n        for idx in 0..self.desc.page_count {\n            let wanted = &resolved.pages[&idx];\n            let path = self.pages_dir().join(format!(\"p{idx}\"));\n            let needs_write = match working.get(&idx) {\n                Some(wp) => wp.payload != wanted.payload || wp.version != wanted.version,\n                None => wanted.version != 0 || wanted.payload != vec![0u8; self.desc.page_size as usize],\n            };\n            if needs_write {\n                let raw = encode_page_file(wanted.version, self.desc.page_size, &wanted.payload);\n                atomic_write(self.vfs(), &path, &raw)?;\n            }\n        }\n\n        self.vfs().fault(\"restore.tip\", 1)?;\n        let new_state = DsState {\n            tip: Some(target),\n            next_id: self.state.lock().unwrap().next_id,\n        };\n        self.persist_state(&new_state)?;\n        Ok(resolved.chain)\n    }\n\n    /// Merge an incremental checkpoint (its entire dependency chain) into a\n    /// new self-contained **full** checkpoint. The merge is atomic: a crash\n    /// anywhere before the final rename leaves only a `*.staging` directory\n    /// that is discarded on next open; no existing checkpoint is mutated.\n    pub fn merge(&self, target: u64) -> EngineResult<u64> {\n        let _g = self.lock.lock().unwrap();\n        let meta = self.load_meta(target)?;\n        if meta.kind == CpKind::Full {\n            return Err(EngineError::Invalid(format!(\n                \"checkpoint {target} is already full; nothing to merge\"\n            )));\n        }\n        let resolved = self.resolve(target)?;\n        let state = *self.state.lock().unwrap();\n        let new_id = state.next_id;\n\n        let mut entries: Vec<PageEntry> = Vec::new();\n        let mut data = Vec::new();\n        for idx in 0..self.desc.page_count {\n            let p = &resolved.pages[&idx];\n            entries.push(PageEntry {\n                page: idx,\n                version: p.version,\n                crc: p.crc.clone(),\n            });\n            data.extend_from_slice(&p.payload);\n        }\n        let full_meta = CpMeta {\n            id: new_id,\n            kind: CpKind::Full,\n            parent: None,\n            created_at_unix: unix_now(),\n            page_size: self.desc.page_size,\n            page_count: self.desc.page_count,\n            data_crc: crc32_hex(&data),\n            pages: entries,\n        };\n\n        self.commit_checkpoint(&full_meta, &data, \"merge\")?;\n\n        self.vfs().fault(\"merge.tip\", 1)?;\n        let new_state = DsState {\n            tip: Some(new_id),\n            next_id: new_id + 1,\n        };\n        self.persist_state(&new_state)?;\n        Ok(new_id)\n    }\n\n    // -- summaries ----------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /// CRC + version summary of the current working pages.\n    pub fn working_digests(&self) -> EngineResult<Vec<PageDigest>> {\n        let working = self.load_working()?;\n        Ok((0..self.desc.page_count)\n            .map(|idx| match working.get(&idx) {\n                Some(wp) => PageDigest {\n                    page: idx,\n                    version: wp.version,\n                    source: None,\n                    crc: crc32_hex(&wp.payload),\n                },\n                None => PageDigest {\n                    page: idx,\n                    version: 0,\n                    source: None,\n                    crc: crc32_hex(&vec![0u8; self.desc.page_size as usize]),\n                },\n            })\n            .collect())\n    }\n\n    /// CRC + version summary of a checkpoint after applying its full chain.\n    /// `source` identifies which checkpoint in the chain supplied each page.\n    pub fn resolved_digests(&self, target: u64) -> EngineResult<Vec<PageDigest>> {\n        let resolved = self.resolve(target)?;\n        // Determine the contributing checkpoint for each page by replaying the\n        // overlay with provenance.\n        let mut provenance: BTreeMap<u32, u64> = BTreeMap::new();\n        for &id in &resolved.chain {\n            let loaded = self.load_checkpoint(id)?;\n            for entry in &loaded.meta.pages {\n                provenance.insert(entry.page, id);\n            }\n        }\n        Ok((0..self.desc.page_count)\n            .map(|idx| {\n                let p = &resolved.pages[&idx];\n                PageDigest {\n                    page: idx,\n                    version: p.version,\n                    source: provenance.get(&idx).copied(),\n                    crc: p.crc.clone(),\n                }\n            })\n            .collect())\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Metadata structs\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]\nstruct DatasetDesc {\n    // name kept for echo only\n    name: String,\n    page_size: u32,\n    page_count: u32,\n}\n\nimpl DatasetDesc {\n    fn to_json(&self) -> Value {\n        let mut v = Value::obj();\n        v.insert(\"name\", s(&self.name));\n        v.insert(\"page_size\", json::n(self.page_size as u64));\n        v.insert(\"page_count\", json::n(self.page_count as u64));\n        v\n    }\n    fn from_json(v: &Value) -> EngineResult<Self> {\n        let page_size = v.req_u64(\"page_size\")? as u32;\n        let page_count = v.req_u64(\"page_count\")? as u32;\n        if page_size == 0 || page_count == 0 {\n            return Err(EngineError::Corrupt(\"dataset geometry is zero\".into()));\n        }\n        Ok(DatasetDesc {\n            name: v.get(\"name\").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or(\"\").to_string(),\n            page_size,\n            page_count,\n        })\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]\nstruct DsState {\n    tip: Option<u64>,\n    next_id: u64,\n}\n\nimpl DsState {\n    fn to_json(&self) -> Value {\n        let mut v = Value::obj();\n        match self.tip {\n            Some(id) => v.insert(\"tip\", json::n(id)),\n            None => v.insert(\"tip\", Value::Null),\n        }\n        v.insert(\"next_id\", json::n(self.next_id));\n        v\n    }\n    fn from_json(v: &Value) -> EngineResult<Self> {\n        let tip = match v.get(\"tip\") {\n            Some(Value::Null) | None => None,\n            Some(x) => Some(x.as_u64().ok_or_else(|| {\n                EngineError::Corrupt(\"state.tip must be an integer or null\".into())\n            })?),\n        };\n        let next_id = v\n            .get(\"next_id\")\n            .and_then(Value::as_u64)\n            .unwrap_or(1);\n        Ok(DsState {\n            tip,\n            next_id: next_id.max(1),\n        })\n    }\n}\n\nimpl CpMeta {\n    fn to_json(&self) -> Value {\n        let mut v = Value::obj();\n        v.insert(\"id\", json::n(self.id));\n        v.insert(\"kind\", s(self.kind.as_str()));\n        match self.parent {\n            Some(p) => v.insert(\"parent\", json::n(p)),\n            None => v.insert(\"parent\", Value::Null),\n        }\n        v.insert(\"created_at_unix\", json::n(self.created_at_unix));\n        v.insert(\"page_size\", json::n(self.page_size as u64));\n        v.insert(\"page_count\", json::n(self.page_count as u64));\n        v.insert(\"data_crc\", s(&self.data_crc));\n        let pages = self\n            .pages\n            .iter()\n            .map(|p| {\n                let mut o = Value::obj();\n                o.insert(\"page\", json::n(p.page as u64));\n                o.insert(\"version\", json::n(p.version));\n                o.insert(\"crc\", s(&p.crc));\n                o\n            })\n            .collect();\n        v.insert(\"pages\", Value::Arr(pages));\n        v\n    }\n\n    fn from_json(v: &Value) -> EngineResult<Self> {\n        let id = v.req_u64(\"id\")?;\n        let kind = CpKind::parse(&v.req_str(\"kind\")?)?;\n        let parent = match v.get(\"parent\") {\n            Some(Value::Null) | None => None,\n            Some(x) => Some(x.as_u64().ok_or_else(|| {\n                EngineError::Corrupt(\"parent must be integer or null\".into())\n            })?),\n        };\n        match kind {\n            CpKind::Full if parent.is_some() => {\n                return Err(EngineError::Corrupt(format!(\n                    \"full checkpoint {id} must have null parent\"\n                )));\n            }\n            CpKind::Incremental if parent.is_none() => {\n u64) -> EngineResult<Resolved> {\n        // Collect the raw parent chain target -> root, with cycle detection.\n        let mut reverse_chain: Vec<u64> = Vec::new();\n        let mut on_path = reverse_chain.is_empty() {\n                    Err(EngineError::CheckpointNotFound(id.to_string()))\n                } else {\n                    let child = *reverse_chain.last().unwrap();\n reverse_chain.push(id);\n            cur = match meta.kind {\n                CpKind::Full => {\n                    if meta.parent.is_some() {\n                        return Err(EngineError::Corrupt(format!(\n                            \"full checkpoint {id} must not have a parent\"\n                        )));\n                    }\n                    None\n \"incremental checkpoint {id} has no parent\"\n                        ))\n                    })?;\n                    Some(p)\n                }\n            };\n        }\n\n        let chain: Vec<u64> = reverse_chain.into_iter().rev().collect();\n        let mut pages: BTreeMap<u32, ResolvedPage> = BTreeMap::new();\n        for (pos, &id) in chain.iter().enumerate() {\n            let loaded = self.load_checkpoint(id)?;\n            let is_root = pos == 0;\n            if loaded.meta.kind == CpKind::Full {\n                if !is_root {\n                    return self.desc.page_count {\n                    return Err(EngineError::Corrupt(format!(\n                        \"full checkpoint {id} does not cover every page\"\n                    )));\n
