Every page is rewritten atomically; page files whose\n    /// content is unchanged are left alone.\n    pub fn restore(&self, target: u64) -> EngineResult<Vec<u64>> {\n        let _g = self.lock.lock().unwrap();\n        let resolved = self.resolve(target)?;\n        let working = self.load_working()?;\n\n        for idx in 0..self.desc.page_count {\n            let wanted = &resolved.pages[&idx];\n            let path = self.pages_dir().join(format!(\"p{idx}\"));\n            let needs_write = match working.get(&idx) {\n                Some(wp) => wp.payload != wanted.payload || wp.version != wanted.version,\n                None => wanted.version != 0 || wanted.payload != vec![0u8; self.desc.page_size as usize],\n            };\n            if needs_write {\n                let raw = encode_page_file(wanted.version, self.desc.page_size, &wanted.payload);\n                atomic_write(self.vfs(), &path, &raw)?;\n            }\n        }\n\n        self.vfs().fault(\"restore.tip\", 1)?;\n        let new_state = DsState {\n            tip: Some(target),\n            next_id: self.state.lock().unwrap().next_id,\n        };\n        self.persist_state(&new_state)?;\n        Ok(resolved.chain)\n    }\n\n    /// Merge an incremental checkpoint (its entire dependency chain) into a\n    /// new self-contained **full** checkpoint. state = *self.state.lock().unwrap();\n        let new_id = state.next_id;\n\n        let mut entries: Vec<PageEntry> = Vec::new();\n        let mut data = Vec::new();\n        for idx in {"parentUuid":"e9cecac4-a643-4d61-b37c-726dc5ae27f1","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_cnt26euiimxyeey8jdeljc13","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/a/src/http.rs","content":"//! Tiny std-only HTTP/1.1 framing used by the verification server.\n//!\n//! Deliberately minimal: one request per connection, `Connection: close`,\n//! JSON bodies with `Content-Length`. It is a *local verification entry\n//! point*, not a production web server.\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::TcpStream;\n\nuse crate::error::EngineError;\n\npub struct Request {\n    pub method: String,\n    pub path: String,\n    pub body: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\npub struct Response {\n    pub status: u16,\n    pub body: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\nimpl Response {\n    pub fn json(status: u16, payload: String) -> Self {\n        Response {\n            status,\n            body: payload.into_bytes(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn ok(payload: String) -> Self {\n        Self::json(200, payload)\n    }\n}\n\nfn status_text(code: u16) -> &'static str {\n    match code {\n        200 => \"OK\",\n        400 => \"Bad Request\",\n        404 => \"Not Found\",\n        405 => \"Method Not Allowed\",\n        409 => \"Conflict\",\n        500 => \"Internal Server Error\",\n        _ => \"OK\",\n    }\n}\n\n/// Read exactly one HTTP request from a stream.\npub fn read_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<Request> {\n    let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(8192);\n    let mut tmp = [0u8; 4096];\n    // Read until end of headers.\n    let header_end = loop {\n        if let Some(pos) = find_double_crlf(&buf) {\n            break pos;\n        }\n        let n = stream.read(&mut tmp)?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            return Err(std::io::Error::new(\n                std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof,\n                \"connection closed before full request\",\n            ));\n        }\n        buf.extend_from_slice(&tmp[..n]);\n        if buf.len() > 64 * 1024 * 1024 {\n            return Err(std::io::Error::new(\n                std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                \"headers too large\",\n            ));\n        }\n    };\n\n    let header_block = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..header_end]).to_string();\n    let mut lines = header_block.split(\"\\r\\n\");\n    let request_line = lines.next().unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let mut parts = request_line.splitn(3, ' ');\n    let method = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\").to_string();\n    let path = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\").to_string();\n    let version = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\");\n    if method.is_empty() || path.is_empty() || !version.starts_with(\"HTTP/1.\") {\n        return Err(std::io::Error::new(\n            std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n            \"malformed request line\",\n        ));\n    }\n\n    let mut content_length: usize = 0;\n    for line in lines {\n        if let Some((k, v)) = line.split_once(':') {\n            if k.trim().eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"content-length\") {\n                content_length = v.trim().parse().unwrap_or(0);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let body_start = header_end + 4;\n    let mut body = buf[body_start..].to_vec();\n    while body.len() < content_length {\n        let n = stream.read(&mut tmp)?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            return Err(std::io::Error::new(\n                std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof,\n                \"truncated request body\",\n            ));\n        }\n        body.extend_from_slice(&tmp[..n]);\n    }\n    body.truncate(content_length);\n\n    Ok(Request { method, path, body })\n}\n\nfn find_double_crlf(buf: &[u8]) -> Option<usize> {\n    buf.windows(4).position(|w| w == b\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\")\n}\n\npub fn write_response(stream: &mut TcpStream, resp: &Response) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let head = format!(\n        \"HTTP/1.1 {} {}\\r\\nContent-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8\\r\\nContent-Length: {}\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n\",\n        resp.status,\n        status_text(resp.status),\n        resp.body.len()\n    );\n    stream.write_all(head.as_bytes())?;\n    stream.write_all(&resp.body)?;\n    stream.flush()\n}\n\n/// Standard error envelope: `{\"error\":{\"code\":...,\"message\":...}}`.\npub fn error_response(err: &EngineError) -> Response {\n    let mut v = crate::json::Value::obj();\n    let mut e = crate::json::Value::obj();\n    e.insert(\"code\", crate::json::s(err.code()));\n    e.insert(\"message\", crate::json::s(err.to_string()));\n    v.insert(\"error\", e);\n    Response::json(err.http_status(), crate::json::stringify_pretty(&v))\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_ff5fd5e20564868e673b4cb7","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1087,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":47928,"output_tokens":2130,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"4673abc0-44f9-454d-8702-b50b51eb0247","timestamp":"2026-09-22T15:59:53.645Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/a","sessionId":"6799847f-f3d2-4c99-9138-f5e47176be70","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-a","slug":"merry-wobbling-mochi"}

{"parentUuid":"dafeac5d-b39d-4528-9a01-0c4471a8e001","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_r98qws7qpzywejwk0zg2v91y","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/a/src/server.rs","content":"//! Local HTTP verification server.\n//!\n//! Routes (all request/response bodies are JSON; page payloads travel as\n//! lowercase hex):\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! GET    /health\n//! GET    /datasets\n//! POST   /datasets                       {\"name\",\"page_size\",\"page_count\"}\n//! GET    /datasets/:name\n//! GET    /datasets/:name/pages           working-set summary\n//! GET    /datasets/:name/pages/:idx      one working page (hex payload)\n//! PUT    /datasets/:name/pages/:idx      {\"data\":\"<hex>\"} or {\"fill\":0..255}\n//! POST   /datasets/:name/checkpoints     {\"full\":bool,\"parent\"?:u64}\n//! GET    /datasets/:name/checkpoints     list of checkpoint metadata\n//! GET    /datasets/:name/checkpoints/:id metadata + chain + resolved digests\n//! POST   /datasets/:name/checkpoints/:id/restore\n//! POST   /datasets/:name/checkpoints/:id/merge\n//! GET    /datasets/:name/digests         working digests; ?target=<id> resolved\n//! POST   /faults                         {\"point\":\"merge.commit\"} one-shot I/O fail\n//! DELETE /faults                         clear rules + fired history\n//! GET    /faults                         show configured/history\n//! ```\n\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\nuse std::thread;\n\nuse crate::error::{EngineError, EngineResult};\nuse crate::http::{self, Request, Response};\nuse crate::json::{self, s, Value};\nuse crate::repo::{CpKind, PageDigest, Repository};\nuse crate::vfs::{FaultAction, FaultRule, InjectVfs};\n\npub struct Server {\n    repo: Arc<Repository>,\n    vfs: InjectVfs,\n    /// Serializes mutating requests (faults are process-global anyway).\n    write_lock: Mutex<()>,\n}\n\nimpl Server {\n    pub fn new(root: PathBuf) -> EngineResult<Arc<Self>> {\n        let vfs = InjectVfs::new(Arc::new(crate::vfs::RealVfs::new()));\n        let repo = Repository::open(root, Arc::new(vfs.clone()))?;\n        Ok(Arc::new(Server {\n            repo,\n            vfs,\n            write_lock: Mutex::new(()),\n        })))\n    }\n\n    pub fn listen(self: Arc<Self>, addr: &str) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        let listener = TcpListener::bind(addr)?;\n        eprintln!(\"incremental-checkpoint-engine listening on http://{addr}\");\n        for stream in listener.incoming() {\n            match stream {\n                Ok(stream) => {\n                    let server = self.clone();\n                    thread::spawn(move || {\n                        let _ = server.handle_connection(stream);\n                    });\n                }\n                Err(e) => eprintln!(\"accept failed: {e}\"),\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn handle_connection(&self, mut stream: TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n        let req = match http::read_request(&mut stream) {\n            Ok(r) => r,\n            Err(e) => {\n                eprintln!(\"bad request: {e}\");\n                return Ok(());\n            }\n        };\n        let resp = self.route(&req);\n        http::write_response(&mut stream, &resp)\n    }\n\n    fn route(&self, req: &Request) -> Response {\n        match self.dispatch(req) {\n            Ok(r) => r,\n            Err(e) => http::error_response(&e),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn dispatch(&self, req: &Request) -> EngineResult<Response> {\n        let (path, query) = match req.path.split_once('?') {\n            Some((p, q)) => (p.to_string(), Some(q.to_string())),\n            None => (req.path.clone(), None),\n        };\n        let segs: Vec<&str> = path.trim_matches('/').split('/').collect();\n\n        match (req.method.as_str(), segs.as_slice()) {\n            (\"GET\", [\"health\"]) => Ok(Response::ok(json::stringify(&obj(&[\n                (\"status\", s(\"ok\")),\n            ])))),\n\n            (\"GET\", [\"datasets\"]) => {\n                let names = self.repo.list_datasets()?;\n                let arr = Value::Arr(names.iter().map(|n| s(n)).collect());\n                let mut v = Value::obj();\n                v.insert(\"datasets\", arr);\n                Ok(Response::ok(json::stringify_pretty(&v)))\n            }\n\n            (\"POST\", [\"datasets\"]) => {\n                let _g = self.write_lock.lock().unwrap();\n                let body = parse_body(&req.body)?;\n                let name = body.req_str(\"name\")?;\n                let page_size = body.req_u64(\"page_size\")? as u32;\n                let page_count = body.req_u64(\"page_count\")? as u32;\n                let ds = self.repo.create_dataset(&name, page_size, page_count)?;\n                Ok(Response::json(201, json::stringify_pretty(&dataset_json(&ds))))\n            }\n\n            (\"GET\", [\"datasets\", name]) => {\n                let ds = self.repo.open_dataset(name)?;\n                Ok(Response::ok(json::stringify_pretty(&dataset_json(&ds))))\n            }\n\n            (\"GET\", [\"datasets\", name, \"pages\"]) => {\n                let ds = self.repo.open_dataset(name)?;\n                let digests = ds.working_digests()?;\n                Ok(Response::ok(json::stringify_pretty(&digests_response(\n                    &ds, None, &digests,\n                ))))\n            }\n\n            (\"PUT\", [\"datasets\", name, \"pages\", idx]) => {\n                let _g = self.write_lock.lock().unwrap();\n                let idx: u32 = parse_idx(idx)?;\n                let body = parse_body(&req.body)?;\n                let data = page_payload_from_request(&body, ds_page_size(&self.repo, name, idx)?)?;\n                let ds = self.repo.open_dataset(name)?;\n                let (version, changed) = ds.write_page(idx, &data)?;\n                let mut v = Value::obj();\n                v.insert(\"page\", json::n(idx as u64));\n                v.insert(\"version\", json::n(version));\n                v.insert(\"changed\", json::b(changed));\n                v.insert(\"crc\", s(crate::crc32::crc32_hex(&data)));\n                v.insert(\"tip\", option_json(ds.tip()));\n                Ok(Response::ok(json::stringify_pretty(&v)))\n            }\n\n            (\"GET\", [\"datasets\", name, \"pages\", idx]) => {\n                let idx: u32 = parse_idx(idx)?;\n                let ds = self.repo.open_dataset(name)?;\n                let (version, data) = ds.read_page(idx)?;\n                let mut v = Value::obj();\n                v.insert(\"page\", json::n(idx as u64));\n                v.insert(\"version\", json::n(version));\n                v.insert(\"page_size\", json::n(ds.page_size() as u64));\n                v.insert(\"data\", s(crate::hex::encode_lower(&data)));\n                v.insert(\"crc\", s(crate::crc32::crc32_hex(&data)));\n                Ok(Response::ok(json::stringify_pretty(&v)))\n            }\n\n            (\"POST\", [\"datasets\", name, \"checkpoints\"]) => {\n                let _g = self.write_lock.lock().unwrap();\n                let body = parse_body(&req.body)?;\n                let full = body\n                    .get(\"full\")\n                    .and_then(|v| match v {\n                        Value::Bool(b) => Some(*b),\n                        _ => None,\n                    })\n                    .unwrap_or(false);\n                let parent = match body.get(\"parent\") {\n                    Some(Value::Null) | None => None,\n                    Some(v) => Some(v.as_u64().ok_or_else(|| {\n                        EngineError::Invalid(\"parent must be an integer\".into())\n                    })?),\n                };\n                let ds = self.repo.open_dataset(name)?;\n                let id = ds.checkpoint(full, parent)?;\n                let mut v = Value::obj();\n                v.insert(\"id\", json::n(id));\n                v.insert(\"kind\", s(if full { \"full\" } else { \"incremental\" }));\n                v.insert(\"tip\", json::n(id));\n                Ok(Response::json(201, json::stringify_pretty(&v)))\n            }\n\n            (\"GET\", [\"datasets\", name, \"checkpoints\"]) => {\n                let ds = self.repo.open_dataset(name)?;\n                let metas = ds.list_checkpoints()?;\n                let arr = Value::Arr(metas.iter().map(meta_json).collect());\n                let mut v = Value::obj();\n                v.insert(\"dataset\", s(name));\n                v.insert(\"tip\", option_json(ds.tip()));\n                v.insert(\"checkpoints\", arr);\n                Ok(Response::ok(json::stringify_pretty(&v)))\n            }\n\n            (\"GET\", [\"datasets\", name, \"checkpoints\", id]) => {\n                let id: u64 = parse_idx(id)? as u64;\n                let ds = self.repo.open_dataset(name)?;\n                let metas = ds.list_checkpoints()?;\n                let meta = metas\n                    .into_iter()\n                    .find(|m| m.id == id)\n                    .ok_or_else(|| EngineError::CheckpointNotFound(id.to_string()))?;\n                let digests = ds.resolved_digests(id)?;\n                let mut v = Value::obj();\n                v.insert(\"checkpoint\", meta_json(&meta));\n                v.insert(\"resolved\", digests_response(&ds, Some(id), &digests));\n                Ok(Response::ok(json::stringify_pretty(&v)))\n            }\n\n            (\"POST\", [\"datasets\", name, \"checkpoints\", id, \"restore\"]) => {\n                let _g = self.write_lock.lock().unwrap();\n                let id: u64 = parse_idx(id)? as u64;\n                let ds = self.repo.open_dataset(name)?;\n                let chain = ds.restore(id)?;\n                let digests = ds.working_digests()?;\n                let mut v = digests_response(&ds, Some(id), &digests);\n                v.insert(\"applied_chain\", Value::Arr(chain.iter().map(|x| json::n(*x)).collect()));\n                Ok(Response::ok(json::stringify_pretty(&v)))\n            }\n\n            (\"POST\", [\"datasets\", name, \"checkpoints\", id, \"merge\"]) => {\n                let _g = self.write_lock.lock().unwrap();\n                let id: u64 = parse_idx(id)? as u64;\n                let ds = self.repo.open_dataset(name)?;\n                let new_id = ds.merge(id)?;\n                let digests = ds.resolved_digests(new_id)?;\n                let mut v = Value::obj();\n                v.insert(\"merged_from\", json::n(id));\n                v.insert(\"new_checkpoint\", json::n(new_id));\n                v.insert(\"tip\", json::n(new_id));\n                v.insert(\"resolved\", digests_response(&ds, Some(new_id), &digests));\n                Ok(Response::json(201, json::stringify_pretty(&v)))\n            }\n\n            (\"GET\", [\"datasets\", name, \"digests\"]) => {\n                let ds = self.repo.open_dataset(name)?;\n                let target = query\n                    .as_deref()\n                    .and_then(|q| parse_query(q).get(\"target\").cloned())\n                    .map(|t| t.parse::<u64>())\n                    .transpose()\n                    .map_err(|_| EngineError::Invalid(\"target must be an integer\".into()))?;\n                let digests = match target {\n                    Some(t) => ds.resolved_digests(t)?,\n                    None => ds.working_digests()?,\n                };\n                Ok(Response::ok(json::stringify_pretty(&digests_response(\n                    &ds, target, &digests,\n                ))))\n            }\n\n            (\"POST\", [\"faults\"]) => {\n                let _g = self.write_lock.lock().unwrap();\n                let body = parse_body(&req.body)?;\n                let point = body.req_str(\"point\")?;\n                let at = body.get(\"at\").and_then(Value::as_u64).unwrap_or(1) as usize;\n                let xor = body.get(\"xor\").and_then(Value::as_u64).unwrap_or(0xFF) as u8;\n                let action = if point == \"write.corrupt\" {\n                    let off = body.get(\"byte_offset\").and_then(Value::as_u64)\n                        .map(|x| x as i64)\n                        .unwrap_or(-1);\n                    FaultAction::CorruptWrite {\n                        byte_offset: off,\n                        xor,\n                    }\n                } else {\n                    FaultAction::FailPoint\n                };\n                self.vfs.set_rule(FaultRule {\n                    point: point.clone(),\n                    at,\n                    action,\n                });\n                let mut v = Value::obj();\n                v.insert(\"armed\", s(point));\n                v.insert(\"at\", json::n(at as u64));\n                Ok(Response::json(201, json::stringify_pretty(&v)))\n            }\n\n            (\"DELETE\", [\"faults\"]) => {\n                let _g = self.write_lock.lock().unwrap();\n                self.vfs.clear_rules();\n                Ok(Response::ok(json::stringify(&obj(&[(\"cleared\", json::b(true))]))))\n            }\n\n            (\"GET\", [\"faults\"]) => {\n                let mut v = Value::obj();\n                v.insert(\n                    \"fired\",\n                    Value::Arr(self.vfs.fired().into_iter().map(s).collect()),\n                );\n                Ok(Response::ok(json::stringify_pretty(&v)))\n            }\n\n            _ => Ok(Response::json(\n                404,\n                json::stringify(&obj(&[\n                    (\"error\", s(\"no such route\")),\n                    (\"path\", s(&req.path)),\n                ])),\n            )),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Helpers\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfn parse_body(body: &[u8]) -> EngineResult<Value> {\n    if body.is_empty() {\n        return Ok(Value::obj());\n    }\n    json::parse(&String::from_utf8_lossy(body))\n}\n\nfn parse_idx(s: &str) -> EngineResult<u32> {\n    s.parse::<u32>()\n        .map_err(|_| EngineError::Invalid(format!(\"invalid index '{s}'\")))\n}\n\n/// Look up required payload length before decoding the write body.\nfn ds_page_size(repo: &Repository, name: &str, idx: u32) -> EngineResult<u32> {\n    let ds = repo.open_dataset(name)?;\n    if idx >= ds.page_count() {\n        return Err(EngineError::Invalid(format!(\n            \"page {idx} out of range 0..{}\",\n            ds.page_count()\n        )));\n    }\n    Ok(ds.page_size())\n}\n\nfn page_payload_from_request(body: &Value, page_size: u32) -> EngineResult<Vec<u8>> {\n    if let Some(hex_str) = body.get(\"data\").and_then(Value::as_str) {\n        let data = crate::hex::decode(hex_str)?;\n        if data.len() as u32 != page_size {\n            return Err(EngineError::Invalid(format!(\n                \"data must be {page_size} bytes ({} hex chars), got {}\",\n                page_size * 2,\n                data.len()\n            )));\n        }\n        return Ok(data);\n    }\n    if let Some(fill) = body.get(\"fill\").and_then(Value::as_u64) {\n        if fill > 255 {\n            return Err(EngineError::Invalid(\"fill must be 0..255\".into()));\n        }\n        return Ok(vec![fill as u8; page_size as usize]);\n    }\n    Err(EngineError::Invalid(\n        \"body must contain \\\"data\\\" (hex) or \\\"fill\\\" (0..255)\".into(),\n    ))\n}\n\nfn parse_query(q: &str) -> HashMap<String, String> {\n    let mut map = HashMap::new();\n    for pair in q.split('&') {\n        if let Some((k, v)) = pair.split_once('=') {\n            map.insert(k.to_string(), v.to_string());\n        }\n    }\n    map\n}\n\nfn obj(pairs: &[(&str, Value)]) -> Value {\n    let mut v = Value::obj();\n    for (k, val) in pairs {\n        v.insert(k, val.clone());\n    }\n    v\n}\n\nfn option_json(x: Option<u64>) -> Value {\n    match x {\n        Some(n) => json::n(n),\n        None => Value::Null,\n    }\n}\n\nfn dataset_json(ds: &Arc<crate::repo::Dataset>) -> Value {\n    let mut v = Value::obj();\n    v.insert(\"name\", s(ds.name()));\n    v.insert(\"page_size\", json::n(ds.page_size() as u64));\n    v.insert(\"page_count\", json::n(ds.page_count() as u64));\n    v.insert(\"tip\", option_json(ds.tip()));\n    v\n}\n\nfn meta_json(m: &crate::repo::CpMeta) -> Value {\n    let mut v = Value::obj();\n    v.insert(\"id\", json::n(m.id));\n    v.insert(\n        \"kind\",\n        s(match m.kind {\n            CpKind::Full => \"full\",\n            CpKind::Incremental => \"incremental\",\n        }),\n    );\n    v.insert(\"parent\", option_json(m.parent));\n    v.insert(\"created_at_unix\", json::n(m.created_at_unix));\n    v.insert(\"page_size\", json::n(m.page_size as u64));\n    v.insert(\"page_count\", json::n(m.page_count as u64));\n    v.insert(\"data_crc\", s(&m.data_crc));\n    let pages = m\n        .pages\n        .iter()\n        .map(|p| {\n            obj(&[\n                (\"page\", json::n(p.page as u64)),\n                (\"version\", json::n(p.version)),\n                (\"crc\", s(&p.crc)),\n            ])\n        })\n        .collect();\n    v.insert(\"pages\", Value::Arr(pages));\n    v\n}\n\nfn digests_response(\n    ds: &Arc<crate::repo::Dataset>,\n    target: Option<u64>,\n    digests: &[PageDigest],\n) -> Value {\n    let mut v = Value::obj();\n    v.insert(\"dataset\", s(ds.name()));\n    v.insert(\"page_size\", json::n(ds.page_size() as u64));\n    v.insert(\"page_count\", json::n(ds.page_count() as u64));\n    v.insert(\"target\", option_json(target));\n    let rows = digests\n        .iter()\n        .map(|d| {\n            let mut o = obj(&[\n                (\"page\", json::n(d.page as u64)),\n                (\"version\", json::n(d.version)),\n                (\"crc\", s(&d.crc)),\n            ]);\n            o.insert(\"source\", option_json(d.source));\n            o\n        })\n        .collect();\n    v.insert(\"pages\", Value::Arr(rows));\n    v\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_169be5e539c6151883a07e1c","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1640,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":48952,"output_tokens":5273,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"bef3ff4f-12e9-44ad-8d41-f4807fa0596f","timestamp":"2026-09-22T16:01:27.193Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/a","sessionId":"6799847f-f3d2-4c99-9138-f5e47176be70","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-a","slug":"merry-wobbling-mochi"}

{"parentUuid":"eed129cc-4de5-4d96-bbff-9e8bad03d87e","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_3vv7q0krz2myyv36revosw7q","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/a/tests/engine.rs","content":"//! Integration tests for the incremental checkpoint engine.\n//!\n//! Coverage (acceptance scenarios):\n//! * same page updated many times vs. an in-memory reference model,\n//! * full + incremental chain restore and resolved digests,\n//! * missing parent checkpoint -> strict error,\n//! * fabricated dependency cycle -> strict error,\n//! * checksum corruption (page file and checkpoint data) detected,\n//! * merge interrupted by injected faults at multiple points, then recovery,\n//! * reopen persistence,\n//! * HTTP verification entry point end-to-end.\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::TcpStream;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse ice::crc32::crc32_hex;\nuse ice::error::EngineError;\nuse ice::json::{self, Value};\nuse ice::repo::Repository;\nuse ice::server::Server;\nuse ice::vfs::{FaultRule, InjectVfs, RealVfs};\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// helpers\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstatic COUNTER: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);\n\nfn temp_dir(tag: &str) -> PathBuf {\n    let n = COUNTER.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);\n    let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\n        \"ice-test-{}-{}-{tag}\",\n        std::process::id(),\n        n\n    ));\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n    dir\n}\n\nfn open_repo(dir: &Path) -> Arc<Repository> {\n    Repository::open(dir, Arc::new(RealVfs::new())).unwrap()\n}\n\n/// In-memory reference model of the dataset.\nstruct Model {\n    page_size: usize,\n    pages: Vec<Vec<u8>>,\n    versions: Vec<u64>,\n}\n\nimpl Model {\n    fn new(page_count: u32, page_size: u32) -> Self {\n        Model {\n            page_size: page_size as usize,\n            pages: vec![vec![0u8; page_size as usize]; page_count as usize],\n            versions: vec![0; page_count as usize],\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Set page `idx` to a deterministic pattern (changes on every call with\n    /// different `round`). Returns the bytes written.\n    fn set_pattern(&mut self, idx: u32, round: u8) -> Vec<u8> {\n        let mut data = vec![0u8; self.page_size];\n        for (i, b) in data.iter_mut().enumerate() {\n            *b = round.wrapping_add((i as u8).wrapping_mul(31)).wrapping_add(idx as u8);\n        }\n        self.write(idx, &data);\n        data\n    }\n\n    fn write(&mut self, idx: u32, data: &[u8]) {\n        if self.pages[idx as usize] != data {\n            self.pages[idx as usize] = data.to_vec();\n            self.versions[idx as usize] += 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn snapshot(&self) -> Vec<(u64, String)> {\n        self.pages\n            .iter()\n            .zip(&self.versions)\n            .map(|(p, v)| (*v, crc32_hex(p)))\n            .collect()\n    }\n}\n\n/// Compare engine working digests with the reference snapshot.\nfn assert_working_matches(ds: &Arc<ice::repo::Dataset>, model: &Model) {\n    let digests = ds.working_digests().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(digests.len() as usize, model.pages.len());\n    for (d, (v, crc)) in digests.iter().zip(model.snapshot()) {\n        assert_eq!(d.version, v, \"page {} version mismatch\", d.page);\n        assert_eq!(d.crc, crc, \"page {} crc mismatch\", d.page);\n    }\n}\n\nfn assert_resolved_matches(\n    ds: &Arc<ice::repo::Dataset>,\n    target: u64,\n    model: &Model,\n) -> Vec<u64> {\n    let digests = ds.resolved_digests(target).unwrap();\n    let mut chain = None;\n    for (d, (v, crc)) in digests.iter().zip(model.snapshot()) {\n        assert_eq!(d.version, v, \"page {} resolved version\", d.page);\n        assert_eq!(d.crc, crc, \"page {} resolved crc\", d.page);\n        chain.get_or_insert(());\n    }\n    // Re-fetch the chain for reporting.\n    ds.restore(target).unwrap_err_silent();\n    unreachable!()\n}\n\n// Small shim trait so tests can assert on error variants concisely.\ntrait AssertErr {\n    fn assert_code(&self, expected: &str);\n}\nimpl AssertErr for EngineError {\n    fn assert_code(&self, expected: &str) {\n        assert_eq!(\n            self.code(),\n            expected,\n            \"expected error code {expected}, got {} ({self})\",\n            self.code()\n        );\n    }\n}\n\ntrait UnwrapErrSilent {\n    fn unwrap_err_silent(&self);\n}\nimpl<T> UnwrapErrSilent for Result<T, EngineError> {\n    // Restore is a mutating op; do not call it just to inspect the chain.\n    fn unwrap_err_silent(&self) {\n        panic!(\"do not restore in assert_resolved_matches\");\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 1. Same page updated many times: full + incrementals + merge all agree with\n//    the in-memory model.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn repeated_updates_full_incremental_merge_chain() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"repeated\");\n    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds = repo\n        .create_dataset(\"demo\", 16, 4)\n        .unwrap();\n\n    let mut model = Model::new(4, 16);\n    let mut snapshots: Vec<(u64, Vec<(u64, String)>)> = Vec::new();\n\n    // Round A: touch page 1 repeatedly, then a full checkpoint.\n    for round in 1..=5u8 {\n        let data = model.set_pattern(1, round);\n        let (version, changed) = ds.write_page(1, &data).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(version, round as u64);\n        assert!(changed);\n    }\n    // Writing identical content must not bump the version.\n    let same = model.pages[1].clone();\n    let (version, changed) = ds.write_page(1, &same).unwrap();\n    assert!(!changed);\n    assert_eq!(version, 5);\n    assert_working_matches(&ds, &model);\n\n    let cp_full = ds.checkpoint(true, None).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(cp_full, 1);\n    snapshots.push((cp_full, model.snapshot()));\n\n    // Round B: interleave pages, same page multiple times, then incremental.\n    for round in 6..=10u8 {\n        model.set_pattern(1, round);\n        ds.write_page(1, &model.pages[1]).unwrap();\n        model.set_pattern(3, round);\n        ds.write_page(3, &model.pages[3]).unwrap();\n        model.set_pattern(0, round);\n        ds.write_page(0, &model.pages[0]).unwrap();\n    }\n    assert_working_matches(&ds, &model);\n    let cp_i1 = ds.checkpoint(false, None).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(cp_i1, 2);\n    snapshots.push((cp_i1, model.snapshot()));\n\n    // Incremental must only contain the changed pages.\n    let meta_i1 = ds\n        .list_checkpoints()\n        .unwrap()\n        .into_iter()\n        .find(|m| m.id == cp_i1)\n        .unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(meta_i1.parent, Some(cp_full));\n    assert_eq!(meta_i1.pages.len(), 3, \"only pages 0,1,3 changed\");\n    let changed_pages: Vec<u32> = meta_i1.pages.iter().map(|p| p.page).collect();\n    assert_eq!(changed_pages, vec![0, 1, 3]);\n\n    // Round C: change one page again.\n    model.set_pattern(3, 42);\n    ds.write_page(3, &model.pages[3]).unwrap();\n    let cp_i2 = ds.checkpoint(false, None).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(cp_i2, 3);\n    snapshots.push((cp_i2, model.snapshot()));\n\n    // No-op incremental (nothing changed): valid but empty delta.\n    let cp_i3 = ds.checkpoint(false, None).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(cp_i3, 4);\n    snapshots.push((cp_i3, model.snapshot()));\n\n    // Every checkpoint resolves to its recorded snapshot.\n    for (id, snap) in &snapshots {\n        let digests = ds.resolved_digests(*id).unwrap();\n        for (d, (v, crc)) in digests.iter().zip(snap) {\n            assert_eq!(d.version, *v, \"cp {id} page {} version\", d.page);\n            assert_eq!(&d.crc, crc, \"cp {id} page {} crc\", d.page);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Reopen the repository: tip/state survives.\n    drop(ds);\n    let repo2 = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds2 = repo2.open_dataset(\"demo\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(ds2.tip(), Some(cp_i3));\n    assert_working_matches(&ds2, &model);\n\n    // Restore every checkpoint oldest-first; working set must exactly match\n    // the snapshot taken when the checkpoint was created.\n    for (id, snap) in &snapshots {\n        let chain = ds2.restore(*id).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(*chain.first().unwrap(), cp_full, \"chain always rooted at full\");\n        assert_eq!(*chain.last().unwrap(), *id);\n        let digests = ds2.working_digests().unwrap();\n        for (d, pair) in digests.iter().zip(snap) {\n            assert_eq!(d.version, pair.0);\n            assert_eq!(d.crc, pair.1);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Restore back to the newest tip, then merge to a self-contained full.\n    ds2.restore(cp_i3).unwrap();\n    let merged = ds2.merge(cp_i3).unwrap();\n    assert!(merged > cp_i3);\n    let mmeta = ds2\n        .list_checkpoints()\n        .unwrap()\n        .into_iter()\n        .find(|m| m.id == merged)\n        .unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(mmeta.parent, None);\n    assert_eq!(mmeta.pages.len(), 4, \"merged full covers every page\");\n\n    // The merged checkpoint's resolved pages must equal the pre-merge tip.\n    let merged_digests = ds2.resolved_digests(merged).unwrap();\n    let tip_digests = ds2.resolved_digests(cp_i3).unwrap();\n    for (a, b) in merged_digests.iter().zip(tip_digests.iter()) {\n        assert_eq!(a.crc, b.crc);\n        assert_eq!(a.version, b.version);\n        assert_eq!(a.source, Some(merged), \"every page sourced from the full\");\n    }\n\n    // Restore the merged full on a dataset whose working dir is wiped: still\n    // reconstructs final page content.\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(dir.join(\"datasets/demo/pages\")).unwrap();\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(dir.join(\"datasets/demo/pages\")).unwrap();\n    let repo3 = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds3 = repo3.open_dataset(\"demo\").unwrap();\n    ds3.restore(merged).unwrap();\n    let final_model = &snapshots.last().unwrap().1;\n    let digests = ds3.working_digests().unwrap();\n    for (d, pair) in digests.iter().zip(final_model) {\n        assert_eq!(d.version, pair.0);\n        assert_eq!(d.crc, pair.1);\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 2. Missing parent in the dependency chain.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn missing_parent_is_rejected() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"missing-parent\");\n    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds = repo.create_dataset(\"d\", 8, 2).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[1u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let full = ds.checkpoint(true, None).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[2u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let inc = ds.checkpoint(false, None).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(inc, full + 1);\n\n    // Delete the full checkpoint from under the engine.\n    std::fs::remove_file(dir.join(format!(\"datasets/d/checkpoints/{full}.json\"))).unwrap();\n    std::fs::remove_file(dir.join(format!(\"datasets/d/checkpoints/{full}.data\"))).unwrap();\n\n    let err = ds.resolve(inc).unwrap_err();\n    err.assert_code(\"missing_parent\");\n    match err {\n        EngineError::MissingParent { id, parent } => {\n            assert_eq!(id, inc.to_string());\n            assert_eq!(parent, full.to_string());\n        }\n        other => panic!(\"wrong variant: {other:?}\"),\n    }\n\n    // Restore must refuse too (strict chain application).\n    ds.restore(inc).unwrap_err().assert_code(\"missing_parent\");\n\n    // The orphan incremental is still listed, but cannot participate.\n    assert!(ds\n        .list_checkpoints()\n        .unwrap()\n        .iter()\n        .any(|m| m.id == inc));\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 3. Fabricated dependency cycle.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn dependency_cycle_is_rejected() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"cycle\");\n    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds = repo.create_dataset(\"d\", 8, 2).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[1u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let cp1 = ds.checkpoint(true, None).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[2u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let cp2 = ds.checkpoint(false, None).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[3u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let cp3 = ds.checkpoint(false, None).unwrap();\n\n    // Tamper cp2's metadata: repoint it from cp1 to cp3, making\n    // cp3 -> cp2 -> cp3 a cycle.\n    let path = dir.join(\"datasets/d/checkpoints/{cp2}.json\");\n    let raw = std::fs::read(&path).unwrap();\n    let mut v = json::parse(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw)).unwrap();\n    v.insert(\"parent\", json::n(cp3));\n    std::fs::write(&path, json::stringify_pretty(&v)).unwrap();\n\n    ds.resolve(cp3).unwrap_err().assert_code(\"dependency_cycle\");\n    ds.restore(cp3).unwrap_err().assert_code(\"dependency_cycle\");\n    // cp1 is untouched and still restorable.\n    let chain = ds.restore(cp1).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(chain, vec![cp1]);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 4. Checksum corruption: page files and checkpoint payloads.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn corrupt_page_and_checkpoint_are_detected() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"corrupt\");\n    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds = repo.create_dataset(\"d\", 8, 2).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[7u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let full = ds.checkpoint(true, None).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(1, &[9u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let inc = ds.checkpoint(false, None).unwrap();\n\n    // Corrupt one payload byte of the incremental data file.\n    let data_path = dir.join(\"datasets/d/checkpoints/{inc}.data\");\n    let mut data = std::fs::read(&data_path).unwrap();\n    data[0] ^= 0xFF;\n    std::fs::write(&data_path, data).unwrap();\n    ds.resolve(inc)\n        .unwrap_err()\n        .assert_code(\"checksum_mismatch\");\n\n    // Corrupt a working page file: reads fail closed.\n    let page_path = dir.join(\"datasets/d/pages/p0\");\n    let mut p = std::fs::read(&page_path).unwrap();\n    let last = p.len() - 1;\n    p[last] ^= 0x01;\n    std::fs::write(&page_path, p).unwrap();\n    ds.read_page(0)\n        .unwrap_err()\n        .assert_code(\"checksum_mismatch\");\n    // The untainted full checkpoint still resolves.\n    assert!(ds.resolve(full).is_ok());\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 5. Merge interrupted by injected faults.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfn build_chain(dir: &Path) -> (Arc<Repository>, Arc<ice::repo::Dataset>, InjectVfs, u64) {\n    let inj = InjectVfs::new(Arc::new(RealVfs::new()));\n    let repo = Repository::open(dir, Arc::new(inj.clone())).unwrap();\n    let ds = repo.create_dataset(\"d\", 8, 3).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[1u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(1, &[2u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let _full = ds.checkpoint(true, None).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(2, &[3u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[4u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let tip = ds.checkpoint(false, None).unwrap();\n    (repo, ds, inj, tip)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn merge_interrupted_before_commit_then_succeeds() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"merge-commit-fail\");\n    let (_repo, ds, inj, tip) = build_chain(&dir);\n    let before = ds.resolved_digests(tip).unwrap();\n\n    // Fail the merge at the commit fault point (before any rename).\n    inj.set_rule(FaultRule {\n        point: \"merge.commit\".into(),\n        at: 1,\n        action: ice::vfs::FaultAction::FailPoint,\n    });\n    ds.merge(tip).unwrap_err().assert_code(\"injected_fault\");\n    assert_eq!(inj.fired(), vec![\"merge.commit\".to_string()]);\n\n    // No new checkpoint became visible; staging leftovers are present.\n    let ids: Vec<u64> = ds.list_checkpoints().unwrap().into_iter().map(|m| m.id).collect();\n    assert_eq!(ids, vec![1, 2]);\n    assert!(std::fs::read_dir(dir.join(\"datasets/d/checkpoints\"))\n        .unwrap()\n        .any(|e| e\n            .unwrap()\n            .file_name()\n            .to_string_lossy()\n            .contains(\".staging\")));\n\n    // Clear the fault and retry inside the same process: leftovers cleaned.\n    inj.clear_rules();\n    let merged = ds.merge(tip).unwrap();\n    let after = ds.resolved_digests(merged).unwrap();\n    for (a, b) in after.iter().zip(before.iter()) {\n        assert_eq!(a.crc, b.crc);\n        assert_eq!(a.version, b.version);\n    }\n\n    // Reopen: no staging leftovers survive, merged full is the tip.\n    let repo2 = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds2 = repo2.open_dataset(\"d\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(ds2.tip(), Some(merged));\n    let leftovers: Vec<_> = std::fs::read_dir(dir.join(\"datasets/d/checkpoints\"))\n        .unwrap()\n        .filter_map(|e| {\n            let n = e.unwrap().file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned();\n            n.contains(\".staging\").then_some(n)\n        })\n        .collect();\n    assert!(leftovers.is_empty(), \"staging leftovers: {leftovers:?}\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn merge_interrupted_after_commit_leaves_reusable_orphan() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"merge-postcommit-fail\");\n    let (_repo, ds, inj, tip) = build_chain(&dir);\n    let before = ds.resolved_digests(tip).unwrap();\n\n    // The checkpoint files are durable, but state.json has not advanced.\n    inj.set_rule(FaultRule {\n        point: \"merge.postcommit\".into(),\n        at: 1,\n        action: ice::vfs::FaultAction::FailPoint,\n    });\n    let orphan_id = tip + 1;\n    ds.merge(tip).unwrap_err().assert_code(\"injected_fault\");\n\n    // Tip stayed at the incremental; the orphan full exists on disk and is\n    // already byte-for-byte the correct result.\n    assert_eq!(ds.tip(), Some(tip));\n    let orphan_digests = ds.resolved_digests(orphan_id).unwrap();\n    for (a, b) in orphan_digests.iter().zip(before.iter()) {\n        assert_eq!(a.crc, b.crc);\n        assert_eq!(a.version, b.version);\n        assert_eq!(a.source, Some(orphan_id));\n    }\n\n    // Reopen reconciles id allocation: the next checkpoint must not reuse\n    // the orphan id, and merging again still yields identical content.\n    inj.clear_rules();\n    let repo2 = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds2 = repo2.open_dataset(\"d\").unwrap();\n    let merged = ds2.merge(tip).unwrap();\n    assert!(merged > orphan_id, \"orphan id must never be reused\");\n    let after = ds2.resolved_digests(merged).unwrap();\n    for (a, b) in after.iter().zip(before.iter()) {\n        assert_eq!(a.crc, b.crc);\n        assert_eq!(a.version, b.version);\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 6. Incremental with an explicitly named parent differing from the tip.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn explicit_parent_and_restored_content_roundtrip() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"explicit-parent\");\n    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds = repo.create_dataset(\"d\", 4, 2).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, b\"abcd\").unwrap();\n    let cp1 = ds.checkpoint(true, None).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, b\"efgh\").unwrap();\n    let _cp2 = ds.checkpoint(false, None).unwrap();\n\n    // Roll the working set back to cp1, then branch an incremental off cp1.\n    ds.restore(cp1).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(1, b\"wxyz\").unwrap();\n    let branch = ds.checkpoint(false, Some(cp1)).unwrap();\n\n    let metas = ds.list_checkpoints().unwrap();\n    let branch_meta = metas.iter().find(|m| m.id == branch).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(branch_meta.parent, Some(cp1));\n\n    let digests = ds.resolved_digests(branch).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(digests[0].crc, crc32_hex(b\"abcd\"));\n    assert_eq!(digests[1].crc, crc32_hex(b\"wxyz\"));\n    // Only page 1 differs from cp1's content.\n    assert_eq!(branch_meta.pages.len(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(branch_meta.pages[0].page, 1);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 7. Integration tests for the incremental checkpoint engine.\n//!\n//! Coverage (acceptance scenarios):\n//! * same page updated many times vs. an in-memory reference model,\n//! * full + incremental chain restore and resolved digests,\n//! * missing parent checkpoint -> strict error,\n//! * fabricated dependency cycle -> strict error,\n//! * checksum corruption (page file and checkpoint data) detected,\n//! * merge interrupted by injected faults at multiple points, then recovery,\n//! * reopen persistence,\n//! * HTTP verification entry point end-to-end.\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::TcpStream;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse ice::crc32::crc32_hex;\nuse ice::error::EngineError;\nuse ice::json::{self, Value};\nuse ice::repo::Repository;\nuse ice::server::Server;\nuse ice::vfs::{FaultRule, InjectVfs, RealVfs};\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// helpers\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstatic COUNTER: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);\n\nfn temp_dir(tag: &str) -> PathBuf {\n    let n = COUNTER.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);\n    let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\n        \"ice-test-{}-{}-{tag}\",\n        std::process::id(),\n        n\n    ));\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n    dir\n}\n\nfn open_repo(dir: &Path) -> Arc<Repository> {\n    Repository::open(dir, Arc::new(RealVfs::new())).unwrap()\n}\n\n/// In-memory reference model of the dataset.\nstruct Model {\n    page_size: usize,\n    pages: Vec<Vec<u8>>,\n    versions: Vec<u64>,\n}\n\nimpl Model {\n    fn new(page_count: u32, page_size: u32) -> Self {\n        Model {\n            page_size: page_size as usize,\n            pages: vec![vec![0u8; page_size as usize]; page_count as usize],\n            versions: vec![0; page_count as usize],\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Set page `idx` to a deterministic pattern (changes on every call with\n    /// different `round`). Returns the bytes written.\n    fn set_pattern(&mut self, idx: u32, round: u8) -> Vec<u8> {\n        let mut data = vec![0u8; self.page_size];\n        for (i, b) in data.iter_mut().enumerate() {\n            *b = round.wrapping_add((i as u8).wrapping_mul(31)).wrapping_add(idx as u8);\n        }\n        self.write(idx, &data);\n        data\n    }\n\n    fn write(&mut self, idx: u32, data: &[u8]) {\n        if self.pages[idx as usize] != data {\n            self.pages[idx as usize] = data.to_vec();\n            self.versions[idx as usize] += 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn snapshot(&self) -> Vec<(u64, String)> {\n        self.pages\n            .iter()\n            .zip(&self.versions)\n            .map(|(p, v)| (*v, crc32_hex(p)))\n            .collect()\n    }\n}\n\n/// Compare engine working digests with the reference snapshot.\nfn assert_working_matches(ds: &Arc<ice::repo::Dataset>, model: &Model) {\n    let digests = ds.working_digests().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(digests.len() as usize, model.pages.len());\n    for (d, (v, crc)) in digests.iter().zip(model.snapshot()) {\n        assert_eq!(d.version, v, \"page {} version mismatch\", d.page);\n        assert_eq!(d.crc, crc, \"page {} crc mismatch\", d.page);\n    }\n}\n\nfn assert_resolved_matches(\n    ds: &Arc<ice::repo::Dataset>,\n    target: u64,\n    model: &Model,\n) -> Vec<u64> {\n    let digests = ds.resolved_digests(target).unwrap();\n    let mut chain = None;\n    for (d, (v, crc)) in digests.iter().zip(model.snapshot()) {\n        assert_eq!(d.version, v, \"page {} resolved version\", d.page);\n        assert_eq!(d.crc, crc, \"page {} resolved crc\", d.page);\n        chain.get_or_insert(());\n    }\n    // Re-fetch the chain for reporting.\n    ds.restore(target).unwrap_err_silent();\n    unreachable!()\n}\n\n// Small shim trait so tests can assert on error variants concisely.\ntrait AssertErr {\n    fn assert_code(&self, expected: &str);\n}\nimpl AssertErr for EngineError {\n    fn assert_code(&self, expected: &str) {\n        assert_eq!(\n            self.code(),\n            expected,\n            \"expected error code {expected}, got {} ({self})\",\n            self.code()\n        );\n    }\n}\n\ntrait UnwrapErrSilent {\n    fn unwrap_err_silent(&self);\n}\nimpl<T> UnwrapErrSilent for Result<T, EngineError> {\n    // Restore is a mutating op; do not call it just to inspect the chain.\n    fn unwrap_err_silent(&self) {\n        panic!(\"do not restore in assert_resolved_matches\");\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 1. Same page updated many times: full + incrementals + merge all agree with\n//    the in-memory model.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn repeated_updates_full_incremental_merge_chain() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"repeated\");\n    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds = repo\n        .create_dataset(\"demo\", 16, 4)\n        .unwrap();\n\n    let mut model = Model::new(4, 16);\n    let mut snapshots: Vec<(u64, Vec<(u64, String)>)> = Vec::new();\n\n    // Round A: touch page 1 repeatedly, then a full checkpoint.\n    for round in 1..=5u8 {\n        let data = model.set_pattern(1, round);\n        let (version, changed) = ds.write_page(1, &data).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(version, round as u64);\n        assert!(changed);\n    }\n    // Writing identical content must not bump the version.\n    let same = model.pages[1].clone();\n    let (version, changed) = ds.write_page(1, &same).unwrap();\n    assert!(!changed);\n    assert_eq!(version, 5);\n    assert_working_matches(&ds, &model);\n\n    let cp_full = ds.checkpoint(true, None).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(cp_full, 1);\n    snapshots.push((cp_full, model.snapshot()));\n\n    // Round B: interleave pages, same page multiple times, then incremental.\n    for round in 6..=10u8 {\n        model.set_pattern(1, round);\n        ds.write_page(1, &model.pages[1]).unwrap();\n        model.set_pattern(3, round);\n        ds.write_page(3, &model.pages[3]).unwrap();\n        model.set_pattern(0, round);\n        ds.write_page(0, &model.pages[0]).unwrap();\n    }\n    assert_working_matches(&ds, &model);\n    let cp_i1 = ds.checkpoint(false, None).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(cp_i1, 2);\n    snapshots.push((cp_i1, model.snapshot()));\n\n    // Incremental must only contain the changed pages.\n    let meta_i1 = ds\n        .list_checkpoints()\n        .unwrap()\n        .into_iter()\n        .find(|m| m.id == cp_i1)\n        .unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(meta_i1.parent, Some(cp_full));\n    assert_eq!(meta_i1.pages.len(), 3, \"only pages 0,1,3 changed\");\n    let changed_pages: Vec<u32> = meta_i1.pages.iter().map(|p| p.page).collect();\n    assert_eq!(changed_pages, vec![0, 1, 3]);\n\n    // Round C: change one page again.\n    model.set_pattern(3, 42);\n    ds.write_page(3, &model.pages[3]).unwrap();\n    let cp_i2 = ds.checkpoint(false, None).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(cp_i2, 3);\n    snapshots.push((cp_i2, model.snapshot()));\n\n    // No-op incremental (nothing changed): valid but empty delta.\n    let cp_i3 = ds.checkpoint(false, None).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(cp_i3, 4);\n    snapshots.push((cp_i3, model.snapshot()));\n\n    // Every checkpoint resolves to its recorded snapshot.\n    for (id, snap) in &snapshots {\n        let digests = ds.resolved_digests(*id).unwrap();\n        for (d, (v, crc)) in digests.iter().zip(snap) {\n            assert_eq!(d.version, *v, \"cp {id} page {} version\", d.page);\n            assert_eq!(&d.crc, crc, \"cp {id} page {} crc\", d.page);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Reopen the repository: tip/state survives.\n    drop(ds);\n    let repo2 = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds2 = repo2.open_dataset(\"demo\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(ds2.tip(), Some(cp_i3));\n    assert_working_matches(&ds2, &model);\n\n    // Restore every checkpoint oldest-first; working set must exactly match\n    // the snapshot taken when the checkpoint was created.\n    for (id, snap) in &snapshots {\n        let chain = ds2.restore(*id).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(*chain.first().unwrap(), cp_full, \"chain always rooted at full\");\n        assert_eq!(*chain.last().unwrap(), *id);\n        let digests = ds2.working_digests().unwrap();\n        for (d, pair) in digests.iter().zip(snap) {\n            assert_eq!(d.version, pair.0);\n            assert_eq!(d.crc, pair.1);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Restore back to the newest tip, then merge to a self-contained full.\n    ds2.restore(cp_i3).unwrap();\n    let merged = ds2.merge(cp_i3).unwrap();\n    assert!(merged > cp_i3);\n    let mmeta = ds2\n        .list_checkpoints()\n        .unwrap()\n        .into_iter()\n        .find(|m| m.id == merged)\n        .unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(mmeta.parent, None);\n    assert_eq!(mmeta.pages.len(), 4, \"merged full covers every page\");\n\n    // The merged checkpoint's resolved pages must equal the pre-merge tip.\n    let merged_digests = ds2.resolved_digests(merged).unwrap();\n    let tip_digests = ds2.resolved_digests(cp_i3).unwrap();\n    for (a, b) in merged_digests.iter().zip(tip_digests.iter()) {\n        assert_eq!(a.crc, b.crc);\n        assert_eq!(a.version, b.version);\n        assert_eq!(a.source, Some(merged), \"every page sourced from the full\");\n    }\n\n    // Restore the merged full on a dataset whose working dir is wiped: still\n    // reconstructs final page content.\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(dir.join(\"datasets/demo/pages\")).unwrap();\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(dir.join(\"datasets/demo/pages\")).unwrap();\n    let repo3 = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds3 = repo3.open_dataset(\"demo\").unwrap();\n    ds3.restore(merged).unwrap();\n    let final_model = &snapshots.last().unwrap().1;\n    let digests = ds3.working_digests().unwrap();\n    for (d, pair) in digests.iter().zip(final_model) {\n        assert_eq!(d.version, pair.0);\n        assert_eq!(d.crc, pair.1);\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 2. Missing parent in the dependency chain.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn missing_parent_is_rejected() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"missing-parent\");\n    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds = repo.create_dataset(\"d\", 8, 2).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[1u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let full = ds.checkpoint(true, None).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[2u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let inc = ds.checkpoint(false, None).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(inc, full + 1);\n\n    // Delete the full checkpoint from under the engine.\n    std::fs::remove_file(dir.join(format!(\"datasets/d/checkpoints/{full}.json\"))).unwrap();\n    std::fs::remove_file(dir.join(format!(\"datasets/d/checkpoints/{full}.data\"))).unwrap();\n\n    let err = ds.resolve(inc).unwrap_err();\n    err.assert_code(\"missing_parent\");\n    match err {\n        EngineError::MissingParent { id, parent } => {\n            assert_eq!(id, inc.to_string());\n            assert_eq!(parent, full.to_string());\n        }\n        other => panic!(\"wrong variant: {other:?}\"),\n    }\n\n    // Restore must refuse too (strict chain application).\n    ds.restore(inc).unwrap_err().assert_code(\"missing_parent\");\n\n    // The orphan incremental is still listed, but cannot participate.\n    assert!(ds\n        .list_checkpoints()\n        .unwrap()\n        .iter()\n        .any(|m| m.id == inc));\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 3. Fabricated dependency cycle.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn dependency_cycle_is_rejected() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"cycle\");\n    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds = repo.create_dataset(\"d\", 8, 2).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[1u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let cp1 = ds.checkpoint(true, None).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[2u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let cp2 = ds.checkpoint(false, None).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[3u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let cp3 = ds.checkpoint(false, None).unwrap();\n\n    // Tamper cp2's metadata: repoint it from cp1 to cp3, making\n    // cp3 -> cp2 -> cp3 a cycle.\n    let path = dir.join(\"datasets/d/checkpoints/{cp2}.json\");\n    let raw = std::fs::read(&path).unwrap();\n    let mut v = json::parse(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw)).unwrap();\n    v.insert(\"parent\", json::n(cp3));\n    std::fs::write(&path, json::stringify_pretty(&v)).unwrap();\n\n    ds.resolve(cp3).unwrap_err().assert_code(\"dependency_cycle\");\n    ds.restore(cp3).unwrap_err().assert_code(\"dependency_cycle\");\n    // cp1 is untouched and still restorable.\n    let chain = ds.restore(cp1).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(chain, vec![cp1]);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 4. Checksum corruption: page files and checkpoint payloads.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn corrupt_page_and_checkpoint_are_detected() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"corrupt\");\n    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds = repo.create_dataset(\"d\", 8, 2).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[7u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let full = ds.checkpoint(true, None).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(1, &[9u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let inc = ds.checkpoint(false, None).unwrap();\n\n    // Corrupt one payload byte of the incremental data file.\n    let data_path = dir.join(\"datasets/d/checkpoints/{inc}.data\");\n    let mut data = std::fs::read(&data_path).unwrap();\n    data[0] ^= 0xFF;\n    std::fs::write(&data_path, data).unwrap();\n    ds.resolve(inc)\n        .unwrap_err()\n        .assert_code(\"checksum_mismatch\");\n\n    // Corrupt a working page file: reads fail closed.\n    let page_path = dir.join(\"datasets/d/pages/p0\");\n    let mut p = std::fs::read(&page_path).unwrap();\n    let last = p.len() - 1;\n    p[last] ^= 0x01;\n    std::fs::write(&page_path, p).unwrap();\n    ds.read_page(0)\n        .unwrap_err()\n        .assert_code(\"checksum_mismatch\");\n    // The untainted full checkpoint still resolves.\n    assert!(ds.resolve(full).is_ok());\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 5. Merge interrupted by injected faults.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfn build_chain(dir: &Path) -> (Arc<Repository>, Arc<ice::repo::Dataset>, InjectVfs, u64) {\n    let inj = InjectVfs::new(Arc::new(RealVfs::new()));\n    let repo = Repository::open(dir, Arc::new(inj.clone())).unwrap();\n    let ds = repo.create_dataset(\"d\", 8, 3).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[1u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(1, &[2u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let _full = ds.checkpoint(true, None).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(2, &[3u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[4u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let tip = ds.checkpoint(false, None).unwrap();\n    (repo, ds, inj, tip)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn merge_interrupted_before_commit_then_succeeds() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"merge-commit-fail\");\n    let (_repo, ds, inj, tip) = build_chain(&dir);\n    let before = ds.resolved_digests(tip).unwrap();\n\n    // Fail the merge at the commit fault point (before any rename).\n    inj.set_rule(FaultRule {\n        point: \"merge.commit\".into(),\n        at: 1,\n        action: ice::vfs::FaultAction::FailPoint,\n    });\n    ds.merge(tip).unwrap_err().assert_code(\"injected_fault\");\n    assert_eq!(inj.fired(), vec![\"merge.commit\".to_string()]);\n\n    // No new checkpoint became visible; staging leftovers are present.\n    let ids: Vec<u64> = ds.list_checkpoints().unwrap().into_iter().map(|m| m.id).collect();\n    assert_eq!(ids, vec![1, 2]);\n    assert!(std::fs::read_dir(dir.join(\"datasets/d/checkpoints\"))\n        .unwrap()\n        .any(|e| e\n            .unwrap()\n            .file_name()\n            .to_string_lossy()\n            .contains(\".staging\")));\n\n    // Clear the fault and retry inside the same process: leftovers cleaned.\n    inj.clear_rules();\n    let merged = ds.merge(tip).unwrap();\n    let after = ds.resolved_digests(merged).unwrap();\n    for (a, b) in after.iter().zip(before.iter()) {\n        assert_eq!(a.crc, b.crc);\n        assert_eq!(a.version, b.version);\n    }\n\n    // Reopen: no staging leftovers survive, merged full is the tip.\n    let repo2 = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds2 = repo2.open_dataset(\"d\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(ds2.tip(), Some(merged));\n    let leftovers: Vec<_> = std::fs::read_dir(dir.join(\"datasets/d/checkpoints\"))\n        .unwrap()\n        .filter_map(|e| {\n            let n = e.unwrap().file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned();\n            n.contains(\".staging\").then_some(n)\n        })\n        .collect();\n    assert!(leftovers.is_empty(), \"staging leftovers: {leftovers:?}\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn merge_interrupted_after_commit_leaves_reusable_orphan() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"merge-postcommit-fail\");\n    let (_repo, ds, inj, tip) = build_chain(&dir);\n    let before = ds.resolved_digests(tip).unwrap();\n\n    // The checkpoint files are durable, but state.json has not advanced.\n    inj.set_rule(FaultRule {\n        point: \"merge.postcommit\".into(),\n        at: 1,\n        action: ice::vfs::FaultAction::FailPoint,\n    });\n    let orphan_id = tip + 1;\n    ds.merge(tip).unwrap_err().assert_code(\"injected_fault\");\n\n    // Tip stayed at the incremental; the orphan full exists on disk and is\n    // already byte-for-byte the correct result.\n    assert_eq!(ds.tip(), Some(tip));\n    let orphan_digests = ds.resolved_digests(orphan_id).unwrap();\n    for (a, b) in orphan_digests.iter().zip(before.iter()) {\n        assert_eq!(a.crc, b.crc);\n        assert_eq!(a.version, b.version);\n        assert_eq!(a.source, Some(orphan_id));\n    }\n\n    // Reopen reconciles id allocation: the next checkpoint must not reuse\n    // the orphan id, and merging again still yields identical content.\n    inj.clear_rules();\n    let repo2 = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds2 = repo2.open_dataset(\"d\").unwrap();\n    let merged = ds2.merge(tip).unwrap();\n    assert!(merged > orphan_id, \"orphan id must never be reused\");\n    let after = ds2.resolved_digests(merged).unwrap();\n    for (a, b) in after.iter().zip(before.iter()) {\n        assert_eq!(a.crc, b.crc);\n        assert_eq!(a.version, b.version);\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 6. Incremental with an explicitly named parent differing from the tip.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn explicit_parent_and_restored_content_roundtrip() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"explicit-parent\");\n    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds = repo.create_dataset(\"d\", 4, 2).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, b\"abcd\").unwrap();\n    let cp1 = ds.checkpoint(true, None).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, b\"efgh\").unwrap();\n    let _cp2 = ds.checkpoint(false, None).unwrap();\n\n    // Roll the working set back to cp1, then branch an incremental off cp1.\n    ds.restore(cp1).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(1, b\"wxyz\").unwrap();\n    let branch = ds.checkpoint(false, Some(cp1)).unwrap();\n\n    let metas = ds.list_checkpoints().unwrap();\n    let branch_meta = metas.iter().find(|m| m.id == branch).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(branch_meta.parent, Some(cp1));\n\n    let digests = ds.resolved_digests(branch).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(digests[0].crc, crc32_hex(b\"abcd\"));\n    assert_eq!(digests[1].crc, crc32_hex(b\"wxyz\"));\n    // Only page 1 differs from cp1's content.\n    assert_eq!(branch_meta.pages.len(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(branch_meta.pages[0].page, 1);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 7. Validation errors.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn request_validation() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"validation\");\n    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n    repo.create_dataset(\"ok\", 8, 2).unwrap();\n    assert!(matches!(\n        repo.create_dataset(\"BAD NAME\", 8, 2),\n        Err(EngineError::BadName(_))\n    ));\n    assert!(matches!(\n        repo.create_dataset(\"zero\", 0, 2),\n        Err(EngineError::Invalid(_))\n    ));\n    assert!(matches!(\n        repo.open_dataset(\"ghost\"),\n        Err(EngineError::DatasetNotFound(_))\n    ));\n    let ds = repo.open_dataset(\"ok\").unwrap();\n    // First incremental without any parent is rejected.\n    assert!(matches!(\n        ds.checkpoint(false, None),\n        Err(EngineError::Invalid(_))\n    ));\n    // Wrong payload size.\n    assert!(matches!(\n        ds.write_page(0, &[1, 2, 3]),\n        Err(EngineError::Invalid(_))\n    ));\n    // Page out of range.\n    assert!(matches!(\n        ds.write_page(99, &[0u8; 8]),\n        Err(EngineError::Invalid(_))\n    ));\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 8. HTTP end-to-end smoke test.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct HttpSession(PathBuf, std::net::TcpListener);\n\nfn spawn_server() -> (String, PathBuf) {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"http\");\n    let server = Server::new(dir.clone()).unwrap();\n    let listener = std::net::TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap().to_string();\n    std::thread::spawn(move || {\n        for stream in listener.incoming().flatten() {\n            let server = server.clone();\n            std::thread::spawn(move || {\n                let _ = server.handle_connection_pub(stream);\n            });\n        }\n    });\n    (addr, dir)\n}\n\nfn http(addr: &str, method: &str, path: &str, body: Option<&str>) -> (u16, Value) {\n    let mut stream = TcpStream::connect(addr).unwrap();\n    let body = body.unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let req = format!(\n        \"{method} {path} HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: localhost\\r\\nContent-Type: application/json\\r\\nContent-Length: {}\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n{body}\",\n        body.len()\n    );\n    stream.write_all(req.as_bytes()).unwrap();\n    let mut raw = Vec::new();\n    stream.read_to_end(&mut raw).unwrap();\n    let split = raw.windows(4).position(|w| w == b\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\").unwrap() + 4;\n    let status: u16 = String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw[..split])\n        .split_whitespace()\n        .nth(1)\n        .unwrap()\n        .parse()\n        .unwrap();\n    let payload = String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw[split..]).to_string();\n    let v = if payload.trim().is_empty() {\n        Value::Null\n    } else {\n        json::parse(&payload).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!(\"bad JSON ({e}): {payload}\"))\n    };\n    (status, v)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_end_to_end() {\n    let (addr, _dir) = spawn_server();\n\n    let (status, _) = http(&addr, \"GET\", \"/health\", None);\n    assert_eq!(status, 200);\n\n    // Create dataset.\n    let (status, v) = http(\n        &addr,\n        \"POST\",\n        \"/datasets\",\n        Some(r#\"{\"name\":\"web\",\"page_size\":4,\"page_count\":3}\"#),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(status, 201, \"{v:?}\");\n\n    // Update page 0 three times, then full checkpoint.\n    for (i, byte) in [1u8, 2, 3].iter().enumerate() {\n        let hex = ice::hex::encode_lower(&[*byte; 4]);\n        let body = format!(r#\"{{\"data\":\"{hex}\"}}\"#);\n        let (status, v) = http(&addr, \"PUT\", \"/datasets/web/pages/0\", Some(&body));\n        assert_eq!(status, 200, \"{v:?}\");\n        assert_eq!(v.get(\"version\").and_then(Value::as_u64), Some((i + 1) as u64));\n    }\n    let (status, v) = http(&addr, \"POST\", \"/datasets/web/checkpoints\", Some(r#\"{\"full\":true}\"#));\n    assert_eq!(status, 201);\n    assert_eq!(v.get(\"id\").and_then(Value::as_u64), Some(1));\n\n    // Update via \"fill\", then incremental.\n    let (status, _) = http(\n        &addr,\n        \"PUT\",\n        \"/datasets/web/pages/2\",\n        Some(r#\"{\"fill\":171}\"#),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(status, 200);\n    let (status, v) = http(&addr, \"POST\", \"/datasets/web/checkpoints\", Some(r#\"{\"full\":false}\"#));\n    assert_eq!(status, 201);\n    assert_eq!(v.get(\"id\").and_then(Value::as_u64), Some(2));\n\n    // Digests reflect the current working set.\n    let (status, v) = http(&addr, \"GET\", \"/datasets/web/digests\", None);\n    assert_eq!(status, 200);\n    let pages = v.get(\"pages\").unwrap().as_array().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(pages.len(), 3);\n    assert_eq!(pages[0].get(\"crc\").unwrap().as_str(), Some(crc32_hex(&[3u8; 4]).as_str()));\n    assert_eq!(pages[2].get(\"crc\").unwrap().as_str(), Some(crc32_hex(&[171u8; 4]).as_str()));\n\n    // Restore cp1 (full): page 2 returns to zeros.\n    let (status, v) = http(&addr, \"POST\", \"/datasets/web/checkpoints/1/restore\", None);\n    assert_eq!(status, 200, \"{v:?}\");\n    let pages = v.get(\"pages\").unwrap().as_array().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(pages[2].get(\"crc\").unwrap().as_str(), Some(crc32_hex(&[0u8; 4]).as_str()));\n\n    // Merge cp2 -> a new full checkpoint; final content must equal the\n    // pre-restore working set (page0=3, page2=0xAB).\n    let (status, v) = http(&addr, \"POST\", \"/datasets/web/checkpoints/2/merge\", None);\n    assert_eq!(status, 201, \"{v:?}\");\n    let merged = v.get(\"new_checkpoint\").unwrap().as_u64().unwrap();\n    let pages = v.get(\"resolved\").unwrap().get(\"pages\").unwrap().as_array().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(pages[0].get(\"crc\").unwrap().as_str(), Some(crc32_hex(&[3u8; 4]).as_str()));\n    assert_eq!(pages[2].get(\"crc\").unwrap().as_str(), Some(crc32_hex(&[171u8; 4]).as_str()));\n\n    // Missing parent simulation via raw HTTP is not possible; instead verify\n    // 404 on unknown checkpoint and 400 on bad hex.\n    let (status, _) = http(&addr, \"POST\", \"/datasets/web/checkpoints/99/restore\", None);\n    assert_eq!(status, 404);\n    let (status, v) = http(\n        &addr,\n        \"PUT\",\n        \"/datasets/web/pages/0\",\n        Some(r#\"{\"data\":\"zz\"}\"#),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(status, 400, \"{v:?}\");\n\n    // Fault injection: arm merge.postcommit, merge the newest chain target,\n    // expect a 500 injected_fault and 201);\n    let (status, v) = http(&addr, \"POST\", \"/datasets/web/checkpoints/2/merge\", None);\n    assert_eq!(status, 500, \"{v:?}\");\n    assert_eq!(\n        v.get(\"error\").unwrap().get(\"code\").unwrap().as_str(),\n        Some(\"injected_fault\")\n    );\n    let (status, v) = http(&addr, \"GET\", \"/faults\", None);\n    assert_eq!(status, 200);\n    assert!(v\n        .get(\"fired\")\n        .unwrap()\n        .as_array()\n        .unwrap()\n        .iter()\n        .any(|f| f.as_str() == Some(\"merge.postcommit\")));\n    let (status, _) =
