{"parentUuid":"632ebd57-df1a-4bb8-873b-0bdffda772b3","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_y6eglfjz4zljnknsjmlzqxe6","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/a/README.md","content":"# 增量检查点引擎 (Incremental Checkpoint Engine)\n\n纯后端、**零第三方依赖**（仅 Rust std）的固定页（fixed-page）存储引擎，支持：\n\n- 文件支持的存储库（file-backed repository），磁盘格式公开且版本化；\n- **全量检查点**与**增量检查点**，记录父检查点 ID、每页版本号与 CRC-32 校验；\n- 恢复时**严格沿父依赖链**应用：父链缺失、循环依赖、校验和损坏一律报错，绝不静默；\n- 将增量链**合并**为自包含的全量检查点，合并结果与链尖端的最终页内容逐页一致；\n- **可注入 I/O 层**（`Vfs` trait）模拟故障点（failpoint）与写入损坏，用于验证崩溃/中断场景；\n- 一个仅依赖 `std::net` 的本地 HTTP 验证入口。\n\n不包含任何前端。\n\n## 构建与运行\n\n```bash\ncargo build --release\ncargo test\n\n# 启动本地验证服务（默认 127.0.0.1:8080，数据目录 ./ice-data）\ncargo run -- --addr 127.0.0.1:8080 --root ./ice-data\n```\n\n要求 Rust 1.74+（使用了 edition 2021 与 let-chain 之外的稳定特性；实测见文末运行记录）。\n\n## 磁盘格式\n\n```text\n<root>/\n  datasets/\n    <name>/\n      dataset.json              # 不可变数据集描述：page_size / page_count\n      state.json                # {tip: <id|null>, next_id: <u64>}\n      pages/\n        p<idx>                  # 每个工作页一个文件（格式见下）\n      checkpoints/\n        <id>.json               # 检查点元数据\n        <id>.data               # 该检查点包含的页负载，页大小 * 条目数\n        cp-<id>.staging.<tag>/  # 崩溃残留；进程打开仓库时清理\n```\n\n### 工作页文件 `pages/p<idx>`（大端序）\n\n| 偏移 | 长度 | 内容 |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| 0 | 8 | 魔数 `ICEPG01\\n` |\n| 8 | 4 | `version`（u32，每页单调递增，初始 1；未写入的零页视为 version 0） |\n| 12 | 4 | `crc32`（u32，对 payload 的 CRC-32） |\n| 16 | 4 | `page_size`（u32，必须与数据集一致） |\n| 20 | page_size | 页负载 |\n\n### 检查点元数据 `<id>.json`\n\n```json\n{\n  \"id\": 2,\n  \"kind\": \"incremental\",\n  \"parent\": 1,\n  \"created_at_unix\": 1727000000,\n  \"page_size\": 64,\n  \"page_count\": 8,\n  \"data_crc\": \"8f12e3aa\",\n  \"pages\": [\n    {\"page\": 3, \"version\": 2, \"crc\": \"1b2a90ef\"}\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n- `kind`: `full`（根，`parent` 必须为 `null`，且必须列出**全部**页）或 `incremental`（`parent` 必须为整数，只列与父快照不同的页）。\n- `pages` 按 `page` 严格升序、不重复；`<id>.data` 是这些页负载按序拼接。\n- 双重校验：`data_crc` 覆盖整个 data 文件；每条 `pages[].crc` 覆盖单页。恢复/合并前两者都会重新计算并比对。\n\n### 同步边界（durability）\n\n所有落盘都遵循同一套崩溃安全序列（见 `src/repo.rs` 的 `atomic_write` / `commit_checkpoint`）：\n\n```text\n1. 在目标目录内写临时文件（.tmp.<pid>-<n>）\n2. fsync(临时文件)            # 数据与 inode 落盘\n3. rename(临时文件, 最终名)    # POSIX 原子替换\n4. fsync(父目录)              # 让目录项（rename）本身持久化\n```\n\n检查点提交先把 `.data/.json` 写进**独立 staging 目录**，再原子 rename 进\n`checkpoints/` 并 fsync 该目录。同步边界划分如下：\n\n- staging 阶段（rename 之前）崩溃：只残留 `*.staging*`，任何现有检查点都不受影响；\n  下次打开仓库时清理。\n- 文件已 rename、`state.json` 的 tip 尚未前进时崩溃：留下一个**孤儿但有效**的全量/增量检查点，\n  仍可按 id 解析；`next_id` 在重新打开时按磁盘最大 id 对账，**id 永不复用**。\n- 元数据严格校验：full 必须无父且覆盖全页、incremental 必须有父、页号升序唯一、\n  几何尺寸必须与数据集一致。\n\n目录 fsync 在 Unix 上通过 `open(O_RDONLY)` + `fsync` 实现；非 POSIX 平台降级为尽力而为。\n\n## 依赖链与恢复语义\n\n`resolve(target)` 严格沿 `parent` 指针走到一个 full 根：\n\n1. 目标不存在 → `checkpoint_not_found`；\n2. 链上某父检查点文件缺失 → `missing_parent`（错误中给出子 id 与缺失父 id）；\n3. 沿链重复访问到同一 id → `dependency_cycle`；\n4. 链上任何检查点结构非法或 CRC 不符 → `corrupt` / `checksum_mismatch`；\n5. 从根到目标依次叠加（overlay），最终必须解析出**全部**页，否则报 `corrupt`。\n\n`restore(target)` 在上述校验通过后逐页原子重写工作集，并把 tip 指向 target。\n`merge(target)` 把整条链解析结果物化为一个**新的全量检查点**（不修改任何旧检查点），\n其每页 CRC/版本与合并前链尖端完全一致。\n\n增量检查点只记录\"与父快照不同的页\"；对同一页的多次更新只影响最终差异与该页的版本号。\n\n## HTTP 接口\n\n请求/响应均为 JSON；页负载用小写十六进制传输。服务绑定回环地址，仅用于本地验证。\n\n| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| GET | `/health` | 健康检查 |\n| GET | `/datasets` | 列出数据集 |\n| POST | `/datasets` | `{\"name\",\"page_size\",\"page_count\"}` |\n| GET | `/datasets/:name` | 数据集信息（含 tip） |\n| GET | `/datasets/:name/pages` | 工作集逐页摘要（version + crc） |\n| GET | `/datasets/:name/pages/:idx` | 单页内容（`data` 为 hex） |\n| PUT | `/datasets/:name/pages/:idx` | `{\"data\":\"<hex>\"}` 或 `{\"fill\":0..255}`；内容相同不增版本 |\n| POST | `/datasets/:name/checkpoints` | `{\"full\":true}` 或 `{\"full\":false,\"parent\"?:id}` |\n| GET | `/datasets/:name/checkpoints` | 检查点元数据列表 |\n| GET | `/datasets/:name/checkpoints/:id` | 元数据 + 沿链解析后的逐页摘要（含 source） |\n| POST | `/datasets/:name/checkpoints/:id/restore` | 严格沿链恢复 |\n| POST | `/datasets/:name/checkpoints/:id/merge` | 合并为新全量检查点 |\n| GET | `/datasets/:name/digests?target=<id>` | 不传 target 为工作集摘要；传 target 为链解析摘要 |\n| POST | `/faults` | 安装一次性故障规则（见下） |\n| GET | `/faults` | 已触发故障点历史 |\n| DELETE | `/faults` | 清除全部规则与历史 |\n\n错误统一为 `{\"error\":{\"code\":\"...\",\"message\":\"...\"}}`，常见 code：\n`invalid_request` / `dataset_not_found` / `checkpoint_not_found` /\n`missing_parent` / `dependency_cycle` / `checksum_mismatch` /\n`corrupt` / `injected_fault`。\n\n### 故障注入\n\n```json\nPOST /faults\n{\"point\": \"merge.commit\"}\n```\n\n故障点（均为一次性触发，`\"at\"` 可指定第几次命中，默认 1）：\n\n- `checkpoint.write` / `merge.write`：写 staging 前失败；\n- `checkpoint.commit` / `merge.commit`：rename 提交前失败；\n- `checkpoint.postcommit` / `merge.postcommit`：文件已落盘、tip 更新前失败（模拟孤儿检查点）；\n- `restore.tip` / `page.write`：恢复推进 tip 前 / 页写入后。\n\n`{\"point\":\"write.corrupt\",\"byte_offset\":-1,\"xor\":255}` 是特殊规则：此后每次 `write`\n都会翻转指定偏移（负数表示距末尾）的字节，用于直接制造校验和失配（该规则持续生效直到\n`DELETE /faults`）。\n\n可直接运行 `examples/requests.sh` 走一遍完整流程（需服务已启动）：\n\n```bash\n./examples/requests.sh\n```\n\n## 项目结构\n\n```text\nsrc/\n  error.rs     # 错误类型、稳定 code 与 HTTP 状态映射\n  crc32.rs     # CRC-32（0xEDB88320），标准校验向量测试\n  hex.rs       # hex 编解码\n  json.rs      # std-only JSON 解析/序列化（保序对象）\n  vfs.rs       # Vfs trait / RealVfs(fsync) / InjectVfs(failpoint + 写损坏)\n  repo.rs      # 磁盘格式、工作页、检查点、依赖链、恢复、合并\n  http.rs      # 最小 HTTP/1.1 组帧\n  server.rs    # 路由与处理\n  main.rs      # ice-server\ntests/\n  engine.rs    # 验收场景自动化测试\nexamples/\n  requests.sh  # curl 请求样例\n```\n\n## 测试覆盖（验收对照）\n\n`tests/engine.rs`：\n\n1. **同页多次更新**：内存参考模型逐次写页（同一页连写 5 轮、再跨页交错更新），\n   每个全量/增量检查点解析后的逐页 version+CRC 与当时模型快照逐项对照；\n   合并后的全量与链尖端摘要一致；清空 pages 目录后仅靠检查点仍可还原。\n2. **父链缺失**：删除 full 根后 resolve/restore 返回 `missing_parent` 且携带正确 id。\n3. **循环依赖**：篡改元数据把父指针回指形成 cp3→cp2→cp3，返回 `dependency_cycle`；\n   未受影响的 cp1 仍可恢复。\n4. **校验和损坏**：翻转检查点 data 字节与工作页文件字节，分别返回 `checksum_mismatch`。\n5. **合并中断**：在 `merge.commit`（提交前）与 `merge.postcommit`（提交后 tip 前）\n   注入故障，验证重试成功、暂存残留被清理、孤儿 id 不复用、最终页摘要不变。\n6. 显式指定父 id 的分支增量、参数校验、HTTP 端到端（含故障注入往返）。\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_3b7df4b9c7f29fe760840e17","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2068,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":79672,"output_tokens":7631,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"a6bb65d6-f4d4-4c9b-a05d-b32f5031c0ba","timestamp":"2026-09-22T16:20:55.844Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/a","sessionId":"6799847f-f3d2-4c99-9138-f5e47176be70","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-a","slug":"merry-wobbling-mochi"}

echo\n\necho \"== update page 3 again, incremental (id=3) ==\"\ncurl -sS -X PUT \"$BASE/datasets/$DS/pages/3\" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"fill\":221}' | j; echo\ncurl -sS -X POST \"$BASE/datasets/$DS/checkpoints\" \\\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"full\":false}' | j; echo\n\necho \"== working digests ==\"\ncurl -sS \"$BASE/datasets/$DS/digests\" | j; echo\n\necho \"== resolved digests of checkpoint 2 (chain 1 -> 2) ==\"\ncurl -sS \"$BASE/datasets/$DS/digests?target=2\" | j; echo\n\necho \"== restore checkpoint 1 (pages 1/3 return to zeros) ==\"\ncurl -sS -X POST \"$BASE/datasets/$DS/checkpoints/1/restore\" | j; echo\n\necho \"== merge checkpoint 3 into a new self-contained full checkpoint ==\"\ncurl -sS -X POST \"$BASE/datasets/$DS/checkpoints/3/merge\" | j; back)"}]},"uuid":"1775aaf2-36ee-4951-ae68-940a6b215b6b","timestamp":"2026-09-22T16:20:56.026Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"create","filePath":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/a/README.md","content":"# 增量检查点引擎 (Incremental Checkpoint Engine)\n\n纯后端、**零第三方依赖**（仅 Rust std）的固定页（fixed-page）存储引擎，支持：\n\n- 文件支持的存储库（file-backed repository），磁盘格式公开且版本化；\n- **全量检查点**与**增量检查点**，记录父检查点 ID、每页版本号与 CRC-32 校验；\n- 恢复时**严格沿父依赖链**应用：父链缺失、循环依赖、校验和损坏一律报错，绝不静默；\n- 将增量链**合并**为自包含的全量检查点，合并结果与链尖端的最终页内容逐页一致；\n- **可注入 I/O 层**（`Vfs` trait）模拟故障点（failpoint）与写入损坏，用于验证崩溃/中断场景；\n- 一个仅依赖 `std::net` 的本地 HTTP 验证入口。\n\n不包含任何前端。\n\n## 构建与运行\n\n```bash\ncargo build --release\ncargo test\n\n# 启动本地验证服务（默认 127.0.0.1:8080，数据目录 ./ice-data）\ncargo run -- --addr 127.0.0.1:8080 --root ./ice-data\n```\n\n要求 Rust 1.74+（使用了 edition 2021 与 let-chain 之外的稳定特性；实测见文末运行记录）。\n\n## 磁盘格式\n\n```text\n<root>/\n  datasets/\n    <name>/\n      dataset.json              # 不可变数据集描述：page_size / page_count\n      state.json                # {tip: <id|null>, next_id: <u64>}\n      pages/\n        p<idx>                  # 每个工作页一个文件（格式见下）\n      checkpoints/\n        <id>.json               # 检查点元数据\n        <id>.data               # 该检查点包含的页负载，页大小 * 条目数\n        cp-<id>.staging.<tag>/  # 崩溃残留；进程打开仓库时清理\n```\n\n### 工作页文件 `pages/p<idx>`（大端序）\n\n| 偏移 | 长度 | 内容 |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| 0 | 8 | 魔数 `ICEPG01\\n` |\n| 8 | 4 | `version`（u32，每页单调递增，初始 1；未写入的零页视为 version 0） |\n| 12 | 4 | `crc32`（u32，对 payload 的 CRC-32） |\n| 16 | 4 | `page_size`（u32，必须与数据集一致） |\n| 20 | page_size | 页负载 |\n\n### 检查点元数据 `<id>.json`\n\n```json\n{\n  \"id\": 2,\n  \"kind\": \"incremental\",\n  \"parent\": 1,\n  \"created_at_unix\": 1727000000,\n  \"page_size\": 64,\n  \"page_count\": 8,\n  \"data_crc\": \"8f12e3aa\",\n  \"pages\": [\n    {\"page\": 3, \"version\": 2, \"crc\": \"1b2a90ef\"}\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n- `kind`: `full`（根，`parent` 必须为 `null`，且必须列出**全部**页）或 `incremental`（`parent` 必须为整数，只列与父快照不同的页）。\n- `pages` 按 `page` 严格升序、不重复；`<id>.data` 是这些页负载按序拼接。\n- 双重校验：`data_crc` 覆盖整个 data 文件；每条 `pages[].crc` 覆盖单页。恢复/合并前两者都会重新计算并比对。\n\n### 同步边界（durability）\n\n所有落盘都遵循同一套崩溃安全序列（见 `src/repo.rs` 的 `atomic_write` / `commit_checkpoint`）：\n\n```text\n1. 在目标目录内写临时文件（.tmp.<pid>-<n>）\n2. fsync(临时文件)            # 数据与 inode 落盘\n3. rename(临时文件, 最终名)    # POSIX 原子替换\n4. fsync(父目录)              # 让目录项（rename）本身持久化\n```\n\n检查点提交先把 `.data/.json` 写进**独立 staging 目录**，再原子 rename 进\n`checkpoints/` 并 fsync 该目录。同步边界划分如下：\n\n- staging 阶段（rename 之前）崩溃：只残留 `*.staging*`，任何现有检查点都不受影响；\n  下次打开仓库时清理。\n- 文件已 rename、`state.json` 的 tip 尚未前进时崩溃：留下一个**孤儿但有效**的全量/增量检查点，\n  仍可按 id 解析；`next_id` 在重新打开时按磁盘最大 id 对账，**id 永不复用**。\n- 元数据严格校验：full 必须无父且覆盖全页、incremental 必须有父、页号升序唯一、\n  几何尺寸必须与数据集一致。\n\n目录 fsync 在 Unix 上通过 `open(O_RDONLY)` + `fsync` 实现；非 POSIX 平台降级为尽力而为。\n\n## 依赖链与恢复语义\n\n`resolve(target)` 严格沿 `parent` 指针走到一个 full 根：\n\n1. 目标不存在 → `checkpoint_not_found`；\n2. 链上某父检查点文件缺失 → `missing_parent`（错误中给出子 id 与缺失父 id）；\n3. 沿链重复访问到同一 id → `dependency_cycle`；\n4. 链上任何检查点结构非法或 CRC 不符 → `corrupt` / `checksum_mismatch`；\n5. 从根到目标依次叠加（overlay），最终必须解析出**全部**页，否则报 `corrupt`。\n\n`restore(target)` 在上述校验通过后逐页原子重写工作集，并把 tip 指向 target。\n`merge(target)` 把整条链解析结果物化为一个**新的全量检查点**（不修改任何旧检查点），\n其每页 CRC/版本与合并前链尖端完全一致。\n\n增量检查点只记录\"与父快照不同的页\"；对同一页的多次更新只影响最终差异与该页的版本号。\n\n## HTTP 接口\n\n请求/响应均为 JSON；页负载用小写十六进制传输。服务绑定回环地址，仅用于本地验证。\n\n| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| GET | `/health` | 健康检查 |\n| GET | `/datasets` | 列出数据集 |\n| POST | `/datasets` | `{\"name\",\"page_size\",\"page_count\"}` |\n| GET | `/datasets/:name` | 数据集信息（含 tip） |\n| GET | `/datasets/:name/pages` | 工作集逐页摘要（version + crc） |\n| GET | `/datasets/:name/pages/:idx` | 单页内容（`data` 为 hex） |\n| PUT | `/datasets/:name/pages/:idx` | `{\"data\":\"<hex>\"}` 或 `{\"fill\":0..255}`；内容相同不增版本 |\n| POST | `/datasets/:name/checkpoints` | `{\"full\":true}` 或 `{\"full\":false,\"parent\"?:id}` |\n| GET | `/datasets/:name/checkpoints` | 检查点元数据列表 |\n| GET | `/datasets/:name/checkpoints/:id` | 元数据 + 沿链解析后的逐页摘要（含 source） |\n| POST | `/datasets/:name/checkpoints/:id/restore` | 严格沿链恢复 |\n| POST | `/datasets/:name/checkpoints/:id/merge` | 合并为新全量检查点 |\n| GET | `/datasets/:name/digests?target=<id>` | 不传 target 为工作集摘要；传 target 为链解析摘要 |\n| POST | `/faults` | 安装一次性故障规则（见下） |\n| GET | `/faults` | 已触发故障点历史 |\n| DELETE | `/faults` | 清除全部规则与历史 |\n\n错误统一为 `{\"error\":{\"code\":\"...\",\"message\":\"...\"}}`，常见 code：\n`invalid_request` / `dataset_not_found` / `checkpoint_not_found` /\n`missing_parent` / `dependency_cycle` / `checksum_mismatch` /\n`corrupt` / `injected_fault`。\n\n### 故障注入\n\n```json\nPOST /faults\n{\"point\": \"merge.commit\"}\n```\n\n故障点（均为一次性触发，`\"at\"` 可指定第几次命中，默认 1）：\n\n- `checkpoint.write` / `merge.write`：写 staging 前失败；\n- `checkpoint.commit` / `merge.commit`：rename 提交前失败；\n- `checkpoint.postcommit` / `merge.postcommit`：文件已落盘、tip 更新前失败（模拟孤儿检查点）；\n- `restore.tip` / `page.write`：恢复推进 tip 前 / 页写入后。\n\n`{\"point\":\"write.corrupt\",\"byte_offset\":-1,\"xor\":255}` 是特殊规则：此后每次 `write`\n都会翻转指定偏移（负数表示距末尾）的字节，用于直接制造校验和失配（该规则持续生效直到\n`DELETE /faults`）。\n\n可直接运行 `examples/requests.sh` 走一遍完整流程（需服务已启动）：\n\n```bash\n./examples/requests.sh\n```\n\n## 项目结构\n\n```text\nsrc/\n  error.rs     # 错误类型、稳定 code 与 HTTP 状态映射\n  crc32.rs     # CRC-32（0xEDB88320），标准校验向量测试\n  hex.rs       # hex 编解码\n  json.rs      # std-only JSON 解析/序列化（保序对象）\n  vfs.rs       # Vfs trait / RealVfs(fsync) / InjectVfs(failpoint + 写损坏)\n  repo.rs      # 磁盘格式、工作页、检查点、依赖链、恢复、合并\n  http.rs      # 最小 HTTP/1.1 组帧\n  server.rs    # 路由与处理\n  main.rs      # ice-server\ntests/\n  engine.rs    # 验收场景自动化测试\nexamples/\n  requests.sh  # curl 请求样例\n```\n\n## 测试覆盖（验收对照）\n\n`tests/engine.rs`：\n\n1. **同页多次更新**：内存参考模型逐次写页（同一页连写 5 轮、再跨页交错更新），\n   每个全量/增量检查点解析后的逐页 version+CRC 与当时模型快照逐项对照；\n   合并后的全量与链尖端摘要一致；清空 pages 目录后仅靠检查点仍可还原。\n2. **父链缺失**：删除 full 根后 resolve/restore 返回 `missing_parent` 且携带正确 id。\n3. **循环依赖**：篡改元数据把父指针回指形成 cp3→cp2→cp3，返回 `dependency_cycle`；\n   未受影响的 cp1 仍可恢复。\n4. **校验和损坏**：翻转检查点 data 字节与工作页文件字节，分别返回 `checksum_mismatch`。\n5. **合并中断**：在 `merge.commit`（提交前）与 `merge.postcommit`（提交后 tip 前）\n   注入故障，验证重试成功、暂存残留被清理、孤儿 id 不复用、最终页摘要不变。\n6. 显式指定父 id 的分支增量、参数校验、HTTP 端到端（含故障注入往返）。\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a6bb65d6-f4d4-4c9b-a05d-b32f5031c0ba","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/a","sessionId":"6799847f-f3d2-4c99-9138-f5e47176be70","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-a","slug":"merry-wobbling-mochi"}

}\n\necho \"== health ==\"\ncurl -sS \"$BASE/health\" | j; echo\n\necho \"== create dataset '$DS' (page_size=8, page_count=4) ==\"\ncurl -sS -X POST \"$BASE/datasets\" \\\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"$DS\\\",\\\"page_size\\\":8,\\\"page_count\\\":4}\" | j; echo\ncurl -sS -X PUT \"$BASE/datasets/$DS/pages/3\" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"fill\":204}' | j; echo\ncurl -sS -X POST \"$BASE/datasets/$DS/checkpoints\" \\\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"full\":false}' | j; echo\n\necho \"== update page 3 again, incremental (id=3) ==\"\ncurl -sS -X PUT \"$BASE/datasets/$DS/pages/3\" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"fill\":221}' | j; echo\ncurl -sS -X POST \"$BASE/datasets/$DS/checkpoints\" \\\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"full\":false}' | j; echo\n\necho \"== working digests ==\"\ncurl -sS \"$BASE/datasets/$DS/digests\" | j; echo\n\necho \"== resolved digests of checkpoint 2 (chain 1 -> 2) ==\"\ncurl -sS \"$BASE/datasets/$DS/digests?target=2\" | j; echo\n\necho \"== restore checkpoint 1 (pages 1/3 return to zeros) ==\"\ncurl -sS -X POST \"$BASE/datasets/$DS/checkpoints/1/restore\" | j; echo\n\necho \"== merge checkpoint 3 into a new self-contained full checkpoint ==\"\ncurl -sS -X POST \"$BASE/datasets/$DS/checkpoints/3/merge\" | j; s.parse::<u32>()\n        .map_err(|_| EngineError::Invalid(format!(\"invalid index '{s}'\")))\n}\n\nfn parse_id(s: &str) -> EngineResult<u64> {\n    s.parse::<u64>()\n        .map_err(|_| EngineError::Invalid(format!(\"invalid checkpoint id '{s}'\")))\n}\n\n/// Look up required payload length before decoding the write body.\nfn ds_page_size(repo: &Repository, name: &str, idx: u32) -> EngineResult<u32> {\n    let ds = repo.open_dataset(name)?;\n    if idx >= ds.page_count() {\n        return Err(EngineError::Invalid(format!(\n            \"page {idx} out of range 0..{}\",\n            ds.page_count()\n        )));\n    }\n    Ok(ds.page_size())\n}\n\nfn page_payload_from_request(body: &Value, page_size: u32) -> EngineResult<Vec<u8>> {\n    if let Some(hex_str) = body.get(\"data\").and_then(Value::as_str) {\n        let data = crate::hex::decode(hex_str)?;\n        if data.len() as u32 != page_size {\n            return Err(EngineError::Invalid(format!(\n                \"data must be {page_size} bytes ({} hex chars), got {}\",\n                page_size * 2,\n                data.len()\n            )));\n        }\n        return Ok(data);\n    }\n    if let Some(fill) = body.get(\"fill\").and_then(Value::as_u64) {\n        if fill > 255 {\n            return Err(EngineError::Invalid(\"fill must be 0..255\".into()));\n        }\n        return Ok(vec![fill as u8; page_size as usize]);\n    }\n    Err(EngineError::Invalid(\n        \"body must contain \\\"data\\\" (hex) or \\\"fill\\\" (0..255)\".into(),\n    ))\n}\n\nfn parse_query(q: &str) -> HashMap<String, String> {\n    let mut map = HashMap::new();\n    for pair in q.split('&') {\n        if let Some((k, v)) = pair.split_once('=') {\n            map.insert(k.to_string(), v.to_string());\n        }\n    }\n    map\n}\n\nfn obj(pairs: &[(&str, Value)]) -> Value {\n    let mut v = Value::obj();\n    for (k, val) in pairs {\n        v.insert(k, val.clone());\n    }\n    v\n}\n\nfn option_json(x: Option<u64>) -> Value {\n    match x {\n        Some(n) => json::n(n),\n        None => Value::Null,\n    }\n}\n\nfn dataset_json(ds: &Arc<crate::repo::Dataset>) -> Value {\n    let mut v = Value::obj();\n    v.insert(\"name\", s(ds.name()));\n    v.insert(\"page_size\", json::n(ds.page_size() as u64));\n    v.insert(\"page_count\", json::n(ds.page_count() as u64));\n    v.insert(\"tip\", option_json(ds.tip()));\n    v\n}\n\nfn meta_json(m: &crate::repo::CpMeta) -> Value {\n    let mut v = Value::obj();\n    v.insert(\"id\", json::n(m.id));\n    v.insert(\n        \"kind\",\n        s(match m.kind {\n            CpKind::Full => \"full\",\n            CpKind::Incremental => \"incremental\",\n        }),\n    );\n    v.insert(\"parent\", option_json(m.parent));\n    v.insert(\"created_at_unix\", json::n(m.created_at_unix));\n    v.insert(\"page_size\", json::n(m.page_size as u64));\n    v.insert(\"page_count\", json::n(m.page_count as u64));\n    v.insert(\"data_crc\", s(&m.data_crc));\n    let pages = m\n        .pages\n        .iter()\n        .map(|p| {\n            obj(&[\n                (\"page\", json::n(p.page as u64)),\n corrupt_page_and_checkpoint_are_detected() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"corrupt\");\n    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds = repo.create_dataset(\"d\", 8, 2).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, std::fs::write(&data_path, data).unwrap();\n    ds.resolve(inc)\n        .unwrap_err()\n        .assert_code(\"checksum_mismatch\");\n\n    // Corrupt a working page file: reads fail closed.\n    let ds.read_page(0)\n        .unwrap_err()\n        .assert_code(\"checksum_mismatch\");\n    // The untainted full checkpoint still resolves.\n    assert!(ds.resolve(full).is_ok());\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 5. Merge interrupted by injected faults.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfn build_chain(dir: &Path) -> (Arc<Repository>, Arc<ice::repo::Dataset>, InjectVfs, u64) {\n    let inj = InjectVfs::new(Arc::new(RealVfs::new()));\n    let repo = Repository::open(dir, Arc::new(inj.clone())).unwrap();\n    let ds = repo.create_dataset(\"d\", 8, 3).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[1u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(1, &[2u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let _full = ds.checkpoint(true, None).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(2, &[3u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[4u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let tip = ds.checkpoint(false, None).unwrap();\n    (repo, ds, inj, tip)\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn merge_interrupted_before_commit_then_succeeds() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"merge-commit-fail\");\n    let (_repo, ds, inj, tip) = build_chain(&dir);\n    let before = ds.resolved_digests(tip).unwrap();\n\n    // Fail the merge at the commit fault point (before any rename).\n    inj.set_rule(FaultRule {\n        point: \"merge.commit\".into(),\n        at: 1,\n        action: ice::vfs::FaultAction::FailPoint,\n    });\n    ds.merge(tip).unwrap_err().assert_code(\"injected_fault\");\n    assert_eq!(inj.fired(), vec![\"merge.commit\".to_string()]);\n\n    // No new checkpoint became visible; staging leftovers are present.\n    let ids: Vec<u64> = ds.list_checkpoints().unwrap().into_iter().map(|m| m.id).collect();\n    assert_eq!(ids, vec![1, 2]);\n    assert!(std::fs::read_dir(dir.join(\"datasets/d/checkpoints\"))\n        .unwrap()\n        .any(|e| e\n            .unwrap()\n            .file_name()\n            .to_string_lossy()\n            .contains(\".staging\")));\n\n    // Clear the fault and retry inside the same process: leftovers cleaned.\n    inj.clear_rules();\n    let merged = ds.merge(tip).unwrap();\n    let after = ds.resolved_digests(merged).unwrap();\n    for (a, b) in after.iter().zip(before.iter()) {\n        assert_eq!(a.crc, b.crc);\n        assert_eq!(a.version, b.version);\n    }\n\n    // Reopen: no staging leftovers survive, merged full is the tip.\n    let repo2 = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds2 = repo2.open_dataset(\"d\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(ds2.tip(), Some(merged));\n    let leftovers: Vec<_> = std::fs::read_dir(dir.join(\"datasets/d/checkpoints\"))\n        .unwrap()\n        .filter_map(|e| {\n            let n = e.unwrap().file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned();\n            n.contains(\".staging\").then_some(n)\n        })\n        .collect();\n    assert!(leftovers.is_empty(), \"staging leftovers: {leftovers:?}\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn merge_interrupted_after_commit_leaves_reusable_orphan() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"merge-postcommit-fail\");\n    let (_repo, ds, inj, tip) = build_chain(&dir);\n    let before = ds.resolved_digests(tip).unwrap();\n\n    // The checkpoint files are durable, but state.json has not advanced.\n    inj.set_rule(FaultRule {\n        point: \"merge.postcommit\".into(),\n        at: 1,\n        action: ice::vfs::FaultAction::FailPoint,\n    });\n    let orphan_id = tip + 1;\n    ds.merge(tip).unwrap_err().assert_code(\"injected_fault\");\n\n    // Tip stayed at the incremental; the orphan full exists on disk and is\n    // already byte-for-byte the correct result.\n    assert_eq!(ds.tip(), Some(tip));\n    let orphan_digests = ds.resolved_digests(orphan_id).unwrap();\n    for (a, b) in orphan_digests.iter().zip(before.iter()) {\n        assert_eq!(a.crc, b.crc);\n        assert_eq!(a.version, b.version);\n        assert_eq!(a.source, Some(orphan_id));\n    }\n\n    // Reopen reconciles id allocation: the next checkpoint must not reuse\n    // the orphan id, and merging again still yields identical content.\n    inj.clear_rules();\n    let repo2 = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds2 = repo2.open_dataset(\"d\").unwrap();\n    let merged = ds2.merge(tip).unwrap();\n    assert!(merged > orphan_id, \"orphan id must never be reused\");\n    let after = ds2.resolved_digests(merged).unwrap();","numLines":130,"startLine":330,"totalLines":684}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"8dee6ec2-5108-4b6b-a262-495ae7b7742b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/a","sessionId":"6799847f-f3d2-4c99-9138-f5e47176be70","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-a","slug":"merry-wobbling-mochi"}

method: String,\n    pub path: String,\n    pub body: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\npub struct Response {\n    pub status: u16,\n    pub body: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\nimpl Response {\n    pub fn json(status: u16, payload: String) -> Self {\n        Response {\n            status,\n            body: payload.into_bytes(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn ok(payload: String) -> Self {\n        Self::json(200, payload)\n    }\n}\n\nfn status_text(code: u16) -> &'static str {\n    match code {\n        200 => \"OK\",\n        400 => \"Bad Request\",\n        404 => \"Not Found\",\n        405 => \"Method Not Allowed\",\n        409 => \"Conflict\",\n        500 => \"Internal Server Error\",\n        _ => \"OK\",\n    }\n}\n\n/// Read exactly one HTTP request from a stream.\npub fn read_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<Request> {\n    let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(8192);\n    let mut tmp = [0u8; 4096];\n    // Read until end of headers.\n    let header_end = loop {\n        if let Some(pos) = find_double_crlf(&buf) {\n            break pos;\n        }\n        let n = stream.read(&mut tmp)?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            return Err(std::io::Error::new(\n                std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof,\n                \"connection closed before full request\",\n            ));\n        }\n        buf.extend_from_slice(&tmp[..n]);\n        if buf.len() > 64 * 1024 * 1024 {\n            return Err(std::io::Error::new(\n                std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                \"headers too large\",\n            ));\n        }\n    };\n\n    let header_block = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..header_end]).to_string();\n    let mut lines = header_block.split(\"\\r\\n\");\n    let request_line = lines.next().unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let mut parts = request_line.splitn(3, ' ');\n    let method = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\").to_string();\n    let path = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\").to_string();\n    let version = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\");\n    if method.is_empty() || path.is_empty() || !version.starts_with(\"HTTP/1.\") {\n        return Err(std::io::Error::new(\n            std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n            \"malformed request line\",\n        ));\n    }\n\n    let mut content_length: usize = 0;\n    for line in lines {\n        if let Some((k, v)) = line.split_once(':') {\n            if k.trim().eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"content-length\") {\n                content_length = v.trim().parse().unwrap_or(0);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let body_start = header_end + 4;\n    let mut body = buf[body_start..].to_vec();\n    while body.len() < content_length {\n        let n = stream.read(&mut tmp)?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            return Err(std::io::Error::new(\n                std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof,\n                \"truncated request body\",\n            ));\n        }\n        body.extend_from_slice(&tmp[..n]);\n    }\n    body.truncate(content_length);\n\n    Ok(Request { method, path, body })\n}\n\nfn find_double_crlf(buf: &[u8]) -> Option<usize> {\n    buf.windows(4).position(|w| w == b\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\")\n}\n\npub fn write_response(stream: &mut TcpStream, resp: &Response) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let head = format!(\n        \"HTTP/1.1 {} {}\\r\\nContent-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8\\r\\nContent-Length: {}\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n\",\n        resp.status,\n        status_text(resp.status),\n        resp.body.len()\n    );\n    stream.write_all(head.as_bytes())?;\n    stream.write_all(&resp.body)?;\n    stream.flush()\n}\n\n/// Standard error envelope: `{\"error\":{\"code\":...,\"message\":...}}`.\npub fn error_response(err: &EngineError) -> Response {\n    let mut v = crate::json::Value::obj();\n    let mut e = crate::json::Value::obj();\n    e.insert(\"code\", crate::json::s(err.code()));\n    e.insert(\"message\", crate::json::s(err.to_string()));\n    v.insert(\"error\", e);\n    Response::json(err.http_status(), crate::json::stringify_pretty(&v))\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":36,"oldLines":6,"newStart":36,"newLines":7,"lines":[" fn status_text(code: u16) -> &'static str {","     match code {"," }\n248\t        }\n249\t        Ok(())\n250\t    }\n251\t\n252\t    fn maybe_corrupt(&self, data: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {\n253\t        let st = self.state.lock().unwrap();\n254\t        let mut out: }\n263\t            let idx = if byte_offset >= 0 {\n264\t                let idx = byte_offset as usize;\n265\t                if idx >= data.len() {\n266\t                    continue;\n267\t Durability is provided exclusively by [`Vfs::sync_file`] /\n//! [`Vfs::sync_dir`] after writes, and a crash-safe sequence is always:\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! write temp file in target directory\n//! sync_file(temp)                       // data + inode hit the platter\n//! rename(temp, final)                   // atomic on POSIX\n//! sync_dir(directory)                   // the rename itself is durable\n//! ```\n//!\n//! `RealVfs` maps these to `File::sync_all` and a directory\n//! `open(O_RDONLY)` + `fsync`. Anything performed *before* the final\n//! `sync_dir` may be lost on power loss without violating the engine's\n//! guarantees (stale `*.staging` directories are cleaned on open).\n\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::fs::{self, File, OpenOptions};\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nuse crate::error::{EngineError, EngineResult};\n\n/// Abstract filesystem operations used by the engine.\npub trait Vfs: Send + Sync {\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> bool;\n    fn is_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> bool;\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<Vec<u8>>;\n    fn write(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> EngineResult<()>;\n    fn create_dir_all(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()>;\n    fn list_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<Vec<String>>;\n    fn rename(&self, from: &Path, to: &Path) -> EngineResult<()>;\n    fn remove_file(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()>;\n    fn remove_dir_all(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()>;\n\n    /// fsync a regular file.\n    fn sync_file(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()>;\n    /// fsync a directory (needed to persist rename/unlink on POSIX).\n    fn sync_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()>;\n\n    /// Called by the engine at well-defined points in a multi-step operation.\n    /// `point` names the point; `at` is 1-based occurrence of that point in\n    /// the current operation. The default never fails.\n    fn fault(&self, _point: &str, _at: usize) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n/// Filesystem-backed implementation with real fsync.\npub struct RealVfs;\n\nimpl RealVfs {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        RealVfs\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Default for RealVfs {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        RealVfs\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for RealVfs {\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> bool {\n        path.exists()\n    }\n\n    fn is_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> bool {\n        path.is_dir()\n    }\n\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<Vec<u8>> {\n        let mut f = File::open(path)?;\n        let mut buf = Vec::new();\n        f.read_to_end(&mut buf)?;\n        Ok(buf)\n    }\n\n    fn write(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {\n            fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;\n        }\n        let mut f = OpenOptions::new()\n            .write(true)\n            .create(true)\n            .truncate(true)\n            .open(path)?;\n        f.write_all(data)?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn create_dir_all(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n return Ok(out);\n        }\n        for entry in fs::read_dir(path)? {\n            let entry = entry?;\n            if let Some(name) = entry.file_name().to_str() {\n                out.push(name.to_string());\n            }\n        }\n        out.sort();\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &Path, to: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        fs::rename(from, to)?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn remove_file(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        match fs::remove_file(path) {\n            Ok(()) => Ok(()),\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(()),\n            Err(e) => Err(e.into()),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn remove_dir_all(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        match fs::remove_dir_all(path) {\n            Ok(()) => Ok(()),\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(()),\n            Err(e) => Err(e.into()),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn sync_file(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        let f = File::open(path)?;\n        f.sync_all()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    #[cfg(unix)]\n    fn sync_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        // Opening a directory read-only yields O_RDONLY; fsync persists\n        // directory entry changes (rename/unlink) on POSIX.\n        let f = File::open(path)?;\n        f.sync_all()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    #[cfg(not(unix))]\n    fn sync_dir(&self, _path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        // Directory fsync is not exposed on non-POSIX; durability of the\n ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// What happens when a fault rule fires.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum FaultAction {\n    /// Return an I/O error at the named fault point (process stays alive).\n    FailPoint,\n    /// Corrupt one byte at `byte_offset` (from the end when negative) of every\n    /// payload written via `write`.\n    CorruptWrite { byte_offset: i64, xor: u8 },\n}\n\n/// A one-shot deterministic fault rule.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct FaultRule {\n    /// Fault point name, e.g. \"merge.commit\".\n    pub point: String,\n    /// 1-based occurrence; `at == 1` fires the first time the point is hit.\n    pub at: usize,\n    pub action: FaultAction,\n}\n\n/// Shared, mutable fault configuration wrapped around any [`Vfs`].\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub struct InjectVfs {\n    inner: Arc<dyn Vfs>,\n    state: Arc<Mutex<InjectState>>,\n}\n\nstruct InjectState {\n    rules: }\n\n    /// Install (or replace) a one-shot rule.\n    pub fn set_rule(&self, rule: FaultRule) {\n        let mut st = self.state.lock().unwrap();\n        st.hits.insert(rule.point.clone(), 0);\n st.fired.clear();\n    }\n\n    pub fn fired(&self) -> Vec<String> {\n        self.state.lock().unwrap().fired.clone()\n    }\n\n    fn check_point(&self, point: &str) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        let mut st = self.state.lock().unwrap();\n        if let Some(rule) = st.rules.get(point).cloned() {\n            let count = st.hits.entry(point.to_string()).or_insert(0);\n            *count += 1;\n            let at = rule.at.max(1);\n            if *count == at {\n                st.rules.remove(point);\n                st.fired.push(point.to_string());\n                drop(st);\n maybe_corrupt(&self, data: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {\n        let st = self.state.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut out: Option<Vec<u8>> = None;\n        for rule in st.rules.values() {\n            let (byte_offset, xor) = match rule.action {\n                FaultAction::CorruptWrite { byte_offset, xor } => (byte_offset, xor),\n                FaultAction::FailPoint => continue,\n            };\n            if data.is_empty() {\n                continue;\n            }\n            let idx = if byte_offset >= 0 {\n                let idx = byte_offset as usize;\n                if idx >= data.len() {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                idx\n            } else {\n                let back = (-byte_offset) as usize;\n                if back > data.len() {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                data.len() - back\n            };\n            let buf = out.get_or_insert_with(|| data.to_vec());\n            buf[idx] ^= xor;\n path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        self.inner.remove_dir_all(path)\n    }\n    fn sync_file(&self, path: &Path) -> EngineResult<()> {\n        self.inner.sync_file(path)\n    }\n    fn {"parentUuid":"70e21114-da37-412a-a93e-e153e379c150","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"093c59f0-ef6e-44e2-807c-308846500fa7","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"call_ayupg979g3m39hdgf4yazug4","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t//! Integration tests for the incremental checkpoint engine.\n2\t//!\n3\t//! Coverage (acceptance scenarios):\n4\t//! * same page updated many times vs. an in-memory reference model,\n5\t//! * full + incremental chain restore and resolved digests,\n6\t//! * missing parent checkpoint -> strict error,\n7\t//! * fabricated dependency cycle -> strict error,\n8\t//! * checksum corruption (page file and checkpoint data) detected,\n9\t//! * merge interrupted by injected faults at multiple points, then recovery,\n10\t//! * reopen persistence,\n11\t//! * HTTP verification entry point end-to-end.\n12\t\n13\tuse std::io::{Read, Write};\n14\tuse std::net::TcpStream;\n15\tuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n16\tuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\n17\tuse std::sync::Arc;\n18\t\n19\tuse ice::crc32::crc32_hex;\n20\tuse ice::error::EngineError;\n21\tuse ice::json::{self, Value};\n22\tuse ice::repo::Repository;\n23\tuse ice::server::Server;\n24\tuse ice::vfs::{FaultRule, InjectVfs, RealVfs};\n25\t\n26\t// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n27\t// helpers\n28\t// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n29\t\n30\tstatic COUNTER: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);\n31\t\n32\tfn temp_dir(tag: &str) -> PathBuf {\n33\t    let n = COUNTER.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);\n34\t    let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\n35\t        \"ice-test-{}-{}-{tag}\",\n36\t        std::process::id(),\n37\t        n\n38\t    ));\n39\t    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n40\t    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n41\t    dir\n42\t}\n43\t\n44\tfn open_repo(dir: &Path) -> Arc<Repository> {\n45\t    Repository::open(dir, Arc::new(RealVfs::new())).unwrap()\n46\t}\n47\t\n48\t/// In-memory reference model of the dataset.\n49\tstruct Model {\n50\t    page_size: usize,\n51\t    pages: Vec<Vec<u8>>,\n52\t    versions: Vec<u64>,\n53\t}\n54\t\n55\timpl Model {\n56\t    fn new(page_count: u32, page_size: u32) -> Self {\n57\t        Model {\n58\t            page_size: page_size as usize,\n59\t            pages: vec![vec![0u8; page_size as usize]; page_count as usize],\n60\t            versions: vec![0; page_count as usize],\n61\t        }\n62\t    }\n63\t\n64\t    /// Set page `idx` to a deterministic pattern (changes on every call with\n65\t    /// different `round`). Returns the bytes written.\n66\t    fn set_pattern(&mut self, idx: u32, round: u8) -> Vec<u8> {\n67\t        let mut data = vec![0u8; self.page_size];\n68\t        for (i, b) in data.iter_mut().enumerate() {\n69\t            *b = round.wrapping_add((i as u8).wrapping_mul(31)).wrapping_add(idx as u8);\n70\t        }\n71\t        self.write(idx, &data);\n72\t        data\n73\t    }\n74\t\n75\t    fn write(&mut self, idx: u32, data: &[u8]) {\n76\t        if self.pages[idx as usize] != data {\n77\t            self.pages[idx as usize] = data.to_vec();\n78\t            self.versions[idx as usize] += 1;\n79\t        }\n80\t    }\n81\t\n82\t    fn snapshot(&self) -> Vec<(u64, String)> {\n83\t        self.pages\n84\t            .iter()\n85\t            .zip(&self.versions)\n86\t            .map(|(p, v)| (*v, crc32_hex(p)))\n87\t            .collect()\n88\t    }\n89\t}\n90\t\n91\t/// Compare engine working digests with the reference snapshot.\n92\tfn assert_working_matches(ds: &Arc<ice::repo::Dataset>, model: &Model) {\n93\t    let digests = ds.working_digests().unwrap();\n94\t    assert_eq!(digests.len() as usize, model.pages.len());\n95\t    for (d, (v, crc)) in digests.iter().zip(model.snapshot()) {\n96\t        assert_eq!(d.version, v, \"page {} version mismatch\", d.page);\n97\t        assert_eq!(d.crc, crc, \"page {} crc mismatch\", d.page);\n98\t    }\n99\t}\n100\t\n101\t// Small shim trait so tests can assert on error variants concisely.\n102\ttrait AssertErr {\n103\t    fn assert_code(&self, expected: &str);\n104\t}\n105\timpl AssertErr for EngineError {\n106\t    fn assert_code(&self, expected: &str) {\n107\t        assert_eq!(\n108\t            self.code(),\n109\t            expected,\n110\t            \"expected error code {expected}, got {} ({self})\","}]},"uuid":"86b6ce47-de46-4eb0-82b1-bae0fdade3e7","timestamp":"2026-09-22T17:21:23.787Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/a/tests/engine.rs","content":"//! Integration tests for the incremental checkpoint engine.\n//!\n//! Coverage (acceptance scenarios):\n//! * same page updated many times vs. an in-memory reference model,\n//! * full + incremental chain restore and resolved digests,\n//! * missing parent checkpoint -> strict error,\n//! * fabricated dependency cycle -> strict error,\n//! * checksum corruption (page file and checkpoint data) detected,\n//! * merge interrupted by injected faults at multiple points, then recovery,\n//! * reopen persistence,\n//! * HTTP verification entry point end-to-end.\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::TcpStream;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse ice::crc32::crc32_hex;\nuse ice::error::EngineError;\nuse ice::json::{self, Value};\nuse ice::repo::Repository;\nuse ice::server::Server;\nuse ice::vfs::{FaultRule, InjectVfs, RealVfs};\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// helpers\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstatic COUNTER: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);\n\nfn temp_dir(tag: &str) -> PathBuf {\n    let n = COUNTER.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);\n    let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\n        \"ice-test-{}-{}-{tag}\",\n        std::process::id(),\n        n\n    ));\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();\n    dir\n}\n\nfn open_repo(dir: &Path) -> Arc<Repository> {\n    Repository::open(dir, Arc::new(RealVfs::new())).unwrap()\n}\n\n/// In-memory reference model of the dataset.\nstruct Model {\n    page_size: usize,\n    pages: Vec<Vec<u8>>,\n    versions: Vec<u64>,\n}\n\nimpl Model {\n    fn new(page_count: u32, page_size: u32) -> Self {\n        Model {\n            page_size: page_size as usize,\n            pages: vec![vec![0u8; page_size as usize]; page_count as usize],\n            versions: vec![0; page_count as usize],\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Set page `idx` to a deterministic pattern (changes on every call with\n    /// different `round`). Returns the bytes written.\n    fn set_pattern(&mut self, idx: u32, round: u8) -> Vec<u8> {\n        let mut data = vec![0u8; self.page_size];\n        for (i, b) in data.iter_mut().enumerate() {\n            *b = round.wrapping_add((i as u8).wrapping_mul(31)).wrapping_add(idx as u8);\n        }\n        self.write(idx, &data);\n        data\n    }\n\n    fn write(&mut self, idx: u32, data: &[u8]) {\n        if self.pages[idx as usize] != data {\n            self.pages[idx as usize] = data.to_vec();\n            self.versions[idx as usize] += 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn snapshot(&self) -> Vec<(u64, String)> {\n        self.pages\n            .iter()\n            .zip(&self.versions)\n            .map(|(p, v)| (*v, crc32_hex(p)))\n            .collect()\n    }\n}\n\n/// Compare engine working digests with the reference snapshot.\nfn assert_working_matches(ds: &Arc<ice::repo::Dataset>, model: &Model) {\n    let digests = ds.working_digests().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(digests.len() as usize, model.pages.len());\n    for (d, (v, crc)) in digests.iter().zip(model.snapshot()) {\n        assert_eq!(d.version, v, \"page {} version mismatch\", d.page);\n        assert_eq!(d.crc, crc, \"page {} crc mismatch\", d.page);\n    }\n}\n\n// Small shim trait so tests can assert on error variants concisely.\ntrait AssertErr {\n    fn assert_code(&self, expected: &str);\n}\nimpl AssertErr for EngineError {\n    fn assert_code(&self, expected: &str) {\n        assert_eq!(\n            self.code(),\n            expected,\n            \"expected error code {expected}, got {} ({self})\",","numLines":110,"startLine":1,"totalLines":717}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"70e21114-da37-412a-a93e-e153e379c150","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp6/a","sessionId":"6799847f-f3d2-4c99-9138-f5e47176be70","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp6-a","slug":"merry-wobbling-mochi"}

Missing parent in the dependency chain.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn missing_parent_is_rejected() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"missing-parent\");\n    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds = repo.create_dataset(\"d\", 8, 2).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[1u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let full = ds.checkpoint(true, None).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[2u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let inc = ds.checkpoint(false, None).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(inc, full + 1);\n\n    // Delete the full checkpoint from under the engine.\n    std::fs::remove_file(dir.join(format!(\"datasets/d/checkpoints/{full}.json\"))).unwrap();\n    std::fs::remove_file(dir.join(format!(\"datasets/d/checkpoints/{full}.data\"))).unwrap();\n\n    let err = ds.resolve(inc).unwrap_err();\n    err.assert_code(\"missing_parent\");\n    match err {\n        EngineError::MissingParent { id, parent } => {\n            assert_eq!(id, inc.to_string());\n            assert_eq!(parent, full.to_string());\n        }\n        other => panic!(\"wrong variant: {other:?}\"),\n    }\n\n    // Restore must refuse too (strict chain application).\n    ds.restore(inc).unwrap_err().assert_code(\"missing_parent\");\n\n    // The orphan incremental is still listed, but cannot participate.\n    assert!(ds\n        .list_checkpoints()\n        .unwrap()\n        .iter()\n        .any(|m| m.id == inc));\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 3. Fabricated dependency cycle.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn dependency_cycle_is_rejected() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"cycle\");\n    let repo = open_repo(&dir);\n    let ds = repo.create_dataset(\"d\", 8, 2).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[1u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let cp1 = ds.checkpoint(true, None).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[2u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let cp2 = ds.checkpoint(false, None).unwrap();\n    ds.write_page(0, &[3u8; 8]).unwrap();\n    let cp3 = ds.checkpoint(false, None).unwrap();\n\n    // Tamper cp2's metadata: repoint it from cp1 to cp3, making\n    // cp3 -> cp2 -> cp3 a cycle.\n    let path = dir.join(format!(\"datasets/d/checkpoints/{cp2}.json\"));\n    let raw = std::fs::read(&path).unwrap();\n    let mut v = json::parse(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw)).unwrap();\n    v.insert(\"parent\", json::n(cp3));\n    std::fs::write(&path, json::stringify_pretty(&v)).unwrap();\n\n    ds.resolve(cp3).unwrap_err().assert_code(\"dependency_cycle\");\n    ds.restore(cp3).unwrap_err().assert_code(\"dependency_cycle\");\n    // cp1 is untouched and still restorable.\n    let chain = ds.restore(cp1).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(chain, vec![cp1]);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 4. target。\n所有链校验都在写入任何工作页**之前**完成，因此父链缺失/循环/校验错误绝不会改动工作集；\n若逐页写入过程中发生真实 I/O 中断，重新执行同一 restore 即可幂等收敛。\n`merge(target)` 把整条链解析结果物化为一个**新的全量检查点**（不修改任何旧检查点），\n其每页 CRC/版本与合并前链尖端完全一致。","originalFile":"# 增量检查点引擎 (Incremental Checkpoint Engine)\n\n纯后端、**零第三方依赖**（仅 Rust std）的固定页（fixed-page）存储引擎，支持：\n\n- 文件支持的存储库（file-backed repository），磁盘格式公开且版本化；\n- **全量检查点**与**增量检查点**，记录父检查点 ID、每页版本号与 CRC-32 校验；\n- 恢复时**严格沿父依赖链**应用：父链缺失、循环依赖、校验和损坏一律报错，绝不静默；\n- 将增量链**合并**为自包含的全量检查点，合并结果与链尖端的最终页内容逐页一致；\n- **可注入 I/O 层**（`Vfs` trait）模拟故障点（failpoint）与写入损坏，用于验证崩溃/中断场景；\n- 一个仅依赖 `std::net` 的本地 HTTP 验证入口。\n\n不包含任何前端。\n\n## 构建与运行\n\n```bash\ncargo build --release\ncargo test\n\n# 启动本地验证服务（默认 127.0.0.1:8080，数据目录 ./ice-data）\ncargo run -- --addr 127.0.0.1:8080 --root ./ice-data\n```\n\n要求 Rust 1.74+（使用了 edition 2021 与 let-chain 之外的稳定特性；实测见文末运行记录）。\n\n## 磁盘格式\n\n```text\n<root>/\n  datasets/\n    <name>/\n      dataset.json              # 不可变数据集描述：page_size / page_count\n      state.json                # {tip: <id|null>, next_id: <u64>}\n      pages/\n        p<idx>                  # 每个工作页一个文件（格式见下）\n      checkpoints/\n        <id>.json               # 检查点元数据\n        <id>.data               # 该检查点包含的页负载，页大小 * 条目数\n        cp-<id>.staging.<tag>/  # 崩溃残留；进程打开仓库时清理\n```\n\n### 工作页文件 `pages/p<idx>`（大端序）\n\n| 偏移 | 长度 | 内容 |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| 0 | 8 | 魔数 `ICEPG01\\n` |\n| 8 | 4 | `version`（u32，每页单调递增，初始 1；未写入的零页视为 version 0） |\n| 12 | 4 | `crc32`（u32，对 payload 的 CRC-32） |\n| 16 | 4 | `page_size`（u32，必须与数据集一致） |\n| 20 | page_size | 页负载 |\n\n### 检查点元数据 `<id>.json`\n\n```json\n{\n  \"id\": 2,\n  \"kind\": \"incremental\",\n  \"parent\": 1,\n  \"created_at_unix\": 1727000000,\n  \"page_size\": 64,\n  \"page_count\": 8,\n  \"data_crc\": \"8f12e3aa\",\n  \"pages\": [\n    {\"page\": 3, \"version\": 2, \"crc\": \"1b2a90ef\"}\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n- `kind`: `full`（根，`parent` 必须为 `null`，且必须列出**全部**页）或 `incremental`（`parent` 必须为整数，只列与父快照不同的页）。\n- `pages` 按 `page` 严格升序、不重复；`<id>.data` 是这些页负载按序拼接。\n- 双重校验：`data_crc` 覆盖整个 data 文件；每条 `pages[].crc` 覆盖单页。恢复/合并前两者都会重新计算并比对。\n\n### 同步边界（durability）\n\n所有落盘都遵循同一套崩溃安全序列（见 `src/repo.rs` 的 `atomic_write` / `commit_checkpoint`）：\n\n```text\n1. 在目标目录内写临时文件（.tmp.<pid>-<n>）\n2. fsync(临时文件)            # 数据与 inode 落盘\n3. rename(临时文件, 最终名)    # POSIX 原子替换\n4. fsync(父目录)              # 让目录项（rename）本身持久化\n```\n\n检查点提交先把 `.data/.json` 写进**独立 staging 目录**，再原子 rename 进\n`checkpoints/` 并 fsync 该目录。同步边界划分如下：\n\n- staging 阶段（rename 之前）崩溃：只残留 `*.staging*`，任何现有检查点都不受影响；\n  下次打开仓库时清理。\n- 文件已 rename、`state.json` 的 tip 尚未前进时崩溃：留下一个**孤儿但有效**的全量/增量检查点，\n  仍可按 id 解析；`next_id` 在重新打开时按磁盘最大 id 对账，**id 永不复用**。\n- 元数据严格校验：full 必须无父且覆盖全页、incremental 必须有父、页号升序唯一、\n  几何尺寸必须与数据集一致。\n\n目录 fsync 在 Unix 上通过 `open(O_RDONLY)` + `fsync` 实现；非 POSIX 平台降级为尽力而为。\n\n## 依赖链与恢复语义\n\n`resolve(target)` 严格沿 `parent` 指针走到一个 full 根：\n\n1. 目标不存在 → `checkpoint_not_found`；\n2. 链上某父检查点文件缺失 → `missing_parent`（错误中给出子 id 与缺失父 id）；\n3. 沿链重复访问到同一 id → `dependency_cycle`；\n4. 链上任何检查点结构非法或 CRC 不符 → `corrupt` / `checksum_mismatch`；\n5. 从根到目标依次叠加（overlay），最终必须解析出**全部**页，否则报 `corrupt`。\n\n`restore(target)` 在上述校验通过后逐页原子重写工作集，并把 tip 指向 target。\n`merge(target)` 把整条链解析结果物化为一个**新的全量检查点**（不修改任何旧检查点），\n其每页 CRC/版本与合并前链尖端完全一致。\n\n增量检查点只记录\"与父快照不同的页\"；对同一页的多次更新只影响最终差异与该页的版本号。\n\n## HTTP 接口\n\n请求/响应均为 JSON；页负载用小写十六进制传输。服务绑定回环地址，仅用于本地验证。\n\n| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| GET | `/health` | 健康检查 |\n| GET | `/datasets` | 列出数据集 |\n| POST | `/datasets` | `{\"name\",\"page_size\",\"page_count\"}` |\n| GET | `/datasets/:name` | 数据集信息（含 tip） |\n| GET | `/datasets/:name/pages` | 工作集逐页摘要（version + crc） |\n| GET | `/datasets/:name/pages/:idx` | 单页内容（`data` 为 hex） |\n| PUT | `/datasets/:name/pages/:idx` | `{\"data\":\"<hex>\"}` 或 `{\"fill\":0..255}`；内容相同不增版本 |\n| POST | `/datasets/:name/checkpoints` | `{\"full\":true}` 或 `{\"full\":false,\"parent\"?:id}` |\n| GET | `/datasets/:name/checkpoints` | 检查点元数据列表 |\n| GET | `/datasets/:name/checkpoints/:id` | 元数据 + 沿链解析后的逐页摘要（含 source） |\n| POST | `/datasets/:name/checkpoints/:id/restore` | 严格沿链恢复 |\n| POST | `/datasets/:name/checkpoints/:id/merge` | 合并为新全量检查点 |\n| GET | `/datasets/:name/digests?target=<id>` | 不传 target 为工作集摘要；传 target 为链解析摘要 |\n| POST | `/faults` | 安装一次性故障规则（见下） |\n| GET | `/faults` | 已触发故障点历史 |\n| DELETE | `/faults` | 清除全部规则与历史 |\n\n错误统一为 `{\"error\":{\"code\":\"...\",\"message\":\"...\"}}`，常见 code：\n`invalid_request` / `dataset_not_found` / `checkpoint_not_found` /\n`missing_parent` / `dependency_cycle` / `checksum_mismatch` /\n`corrupt` / `injected_fault`。\n\n### 故障注入\n\n```json\nPOST /faults\n{\"point\": \"merge.commit\"}\n```\n\n故障点（均为一次性触发，`\"at\"` 可指定第几次命中，默认 1）：\n\n- `checkpoint.write` / `merge.write`：写 staging 前失败；\n- `checkpoint.commit` / `merge.commit`：rename 提交前失败；\n- `checkpoint.postcommit` / `merge.postcommit`：文件已落盘、tip 更新前失败（模拟孤儿检查点）；\n- `restore.tip` / `page.write`：恢复推进 tip 前 / 页写入后。\n\n`{\"point\":\"write.corrupt\",\"byte_offset\":-1,\"xor\":255}` 是特殊规则：此后每次 `write`\n都会翻转指定偏移（负数表示距末尾）的字节，用于直接制造校验和失配（该规则持续生效直到\n`DELETE /faults`）。\n\n可直接运行 `examples/requests.sh` 走一遍完整流程（需服务已启动）：\n\n```bash\n./examples/requests.sh\n```\n\n## 项目结构\n\n```text\nsrc/\n  error.rs     # 错误类型、稳定 code 与 HTTP 状态映射\n  crc32.rs     # CRC-32（0xEDB88320），标准校验向量测试\n  hex.rs       # hex 编解码\n  json.rs      # std-only JSON 解析/序列化（保序对象）\n  vfs.rs       # Vfs trait / RealVfs(fsync) / InjectVfs(failpoint + 写损坏)\n  repo.rs      # 磁盘格式、工作页、检查点、依赖链、恢复、合并\n  http.rs      # 最小 HTTP/1.1 组帧\n  server.rs    # 路由与处理\n  main.rs      # ice-server\ntests/\n  engine.rs    # 验收场景自动化测试\nexamples/\n  requests.sh  # curl 请求样例\n```\n\n## 测试覆盖（验收对照）\n\n`tests/engine.rs`：\n\n1. **同页多次更新**：内存参考模型逐次写页（同一页连写 5 轮、再跨页交错更新），\n   每个全量/增量检查点解析后的逐页 version+CRC 与当时模型快照逐项对照；\n   合并后的全量与链尖端摘要一致；清空 pages 目录后仅靠检查点仍可还原。\n2. **父链缺失**：删除 full 根后 resolve/restore 返回 `missing_parent` 且携带正确 id。\n3. **循环依赖**：篡改元数据把父指针回指形成 cp3→cp2→cp3，返回 `dependency_cycle`；\n   未受影响的 cp1 仍可恢复。\n4. **校验和损坏**：翻转检查点 data 字节与工作页文件字节，分别返回 `checksum_mismatch`。\n5. **合并中断**：在 `merge.commit`（提交前）与 `merge.postcommit`（提交后 tip 前）\n   注入故障，验证重试成功、暂存残留被清理、孤儿 id 不复用、最终页摘要不变。\n6. 显式指定父 id 的分支增量、参数校验、HTTP
